nodes.title: Async fire-and-track job pattern with consistent status model for all long-running operations
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement a consistent async fire-and-track pattern for all long-running operations, with 202 responses, job_id-based polling, persistent job state, and a uniform status model across all operation types.

nodes.title: A new system component is added without a safety check
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-083. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Lower priority - note at workshop

nodes.title: The system does not show the correct status of a running task
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-086. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower priority

nodes.title: ICD-10 and OPCS release impact analysis with gated activation
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute structured diffs between each NHS Digital ICD-10 and OPCS release and active LEO mappings, block activation until mandatory sign-off records exist for secondary-uses mappings, and retain an auditable change history.

nodes.title: The tool does not show all the knock-on effects of a change to a clinical pathway
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-051. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-108

nodes.title: A retired clinical code is not replaced before the update goes live
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-056. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-112

nodes.title: A change to how the AI reads clinical notes goes live without safety testing
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-067. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-121

nodes.title: System component instructions become incorrect or out of date
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-087. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-137

nodes.title: Terminology hybrid retrieval skips vector search only when top lexical score >= 0.7
nodes.description: The CodingResolver SHALL run the vector-search branch whenever the top lexical score (exact + fulltext merged) is below a configurable threshold, defaulting to 0.70 (TERMINOLOGY_VECTOR_SKIP_SCORE). The vector branch SHALL be skipped only when the top lexical score meets or exceeds the threshold, OR when TERMINOLOGY_ENABLE_VECTOR=false. This rule SHALL apply to both the batched resolve() path and the single-term _resolve_single() path.

nodes.title: An update to the AI reading tool changes how it searches past encounters, making results less accurate
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The AI tool that reads notes misses a clinically important finding
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-002. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-002

nodes.title: An AI-suggested text alias causes the system to wrongly flag a clinical term in patient notes
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-003. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-003

nodes.title: AI tool matches clinical text to the wrong type of clinical code — error not flagged
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-003. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-003

nodes.title: Technical score labels shown in the system are misread by staff, leading to wrong service decisions
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Reference range change control gate: activation blocked without approval record
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that any addition, modification, or retirement of a reference range entry passes through the clinical change control approval workflow before the change is activated, blocking activation at the data layer if no approval record exists.

nodes.title: Wrong reference range applied to a test result
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-017. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Reference range data quality risk - create R-LEO-AI-085

nodes.title: Reference range out of date because a clinical guideline has changed
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-018. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Reference range staleness risk - create R-LEO-AI-086

nodes.title: A reference range is changed without proper approval
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-019. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower probability but regulatory impact - note at workshop

nodes.title: Wrong reference threshold shown for a test result
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-023. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: partial. Linked to reference range risk - create alongside R-LEO-AI-085

nodes.title: An unapproved change goes live in the AI workflow
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-047. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-104

nodes.title: Programme starts before all required setup steps are complete
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-094. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-140

nodes.title: Guideline authoring with mandatory source linkage and staged promotion
nodes.description: The authoring tool SHALL block save-to-active unless each guideline entry cites an authoritative source identifier and passes the configured review stage gates.

nodes.title: A clinical guideline is approved for use without a valid source reference
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-060. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-115

nodes.title: A clinical rule goes live before a clinician has reviewed and approved it
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-066. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-120 - low probability but catastrophic

nodes.title: Reviewer interface for relation assessment with SNOMED structural policy guidance
nodes.description: The system SHALL present each proposed relation link to the reviewer alongside the SNOMED structural policy recommendation for that concept pair, and SHALL support accept, reject, and undo actions from a single review card without requiring additional navigation.

nodes.title: An unauthorised person views private patient records
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-040. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-040

nodes.title: NICE TA and QS impact tracking with SLA timers
nodes.description: The content governance tool SHALL record each new or updated Technology Appraisal and Quality Standard, assess LEO impact, and track time-bound implementation tasks to closure.

nodes.title: AI tool usage costs calculated incorrectly, leading to unexpected charges
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-093. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-093

nodes.title: Clinical guidelines shown to clinicians may be out of date
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-027. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Linked to NICE currency risk

nodes.title: A wrongly written clinical guideline is approved and used in patient care
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-048. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-105

nodes.title: Audit trail records altered or deleted after they are created
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-054. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower probability - but note at workshop for regulatory impact

nodes.title: A NICE obligation with a deadline is not flagged as time-sensitive
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-062. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-117

nodes.title: Guideline withdrawal notification to prior users and permanent audit-trail retention of deprecated entries
nodes.description: The system SHALL notify clinical end users of guideline withdrawals with superseding content references, and SHALL retain deprecated guideline entries permanently in the audit record with withdrawal metadata linked to the associated change request.

nodes.title: A staff member misunderstands on-screen guidance and approves the wrong AI rule, causing incorrect quality reporting figures
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-094 health-literacy overlap with R-081. Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: An out-of-date clinical guideline is still being used to guide patient care
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-059. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-114

nodes.title: Multi-mode encounter shortlisting: keyword, full-text, and vector similarity search with configurable fusion
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply keyword matching, BM25 full-text search, and vector similarity search in parallel across programme-defined clinical domains when shortlisting patient encounters for audit review, with modality fusion weights configurable per programme.

nodes.title: Patient missed by the system and not invited to the programme
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-004. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. No risk on shortlisting false negatives - create R-LEO-AI-078

nodes.title: A patient is wrongly added to a care pathway (false positive)
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-005. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower severity but high volume effect - create R-LEO-AI-079

nodes.title: Reference range CRUD: structured entry with mandatory source traceability and unit of measure
nodes.description: The system SHALL store reference range entries with all of: investigation type SNOMED concept, lower bound, upper bound per band (normal, borderline, critical), unit of measure, source document name, source version, and effective date, rejecting entries with missing mandatory fields at save.

nodes.title: Small-cohort output suppression and low-confidence flagging
nodes.description: The system SHALL suppress or flag with an explicit low-confidence warning any cohort-based output where the matched patient cohort is smaller than the configured minimum size threshold; the warning SHALL state the actual cohort size and the threshold applied, and SHALL prevent primary clinical actions until acknowledged.

nodes.title: Clinicians or patients with visual or vestibular conditions cannot safely read clinical information shown by the system
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The AI tool does not show the clinician how complete the patient data is
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-034. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-097 - high priority for workshop

nodes.title: A changed version of the AI tool is used without proper approval
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-052. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-109 - low probability but high severity

nodes.title: NER-to-SNOMED entity extraction with confidence score and full provenance metadata
nodes.description: The system SHALL extract clinical entities from free text using a NER model and link each entity to a SNOMED CT concept with a confidence score, character span, semantic type, and extraction model version; entities below the confidence threshold SHALL be explicitly routed for disambiguation rather than silently dropped.

nodes.title: A software update causes the AI tool to miss or misread clinical terms in notes
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI tool produces wrong clinical information from patient notes
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Errors in the examples used to teach the AI cause it to suggest wrong clinical codes
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Clinical code saved without a link to its source in the notes
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-021. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. No explicit provenance loss risk - create R-LEO-AI-087

nodes.title: Recovery markers missed from the patient's coded record
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-026. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-090

nodes.title: Change queue item context display, sort/filter, reviewer notification, and escalation for overdue items
nodes.description: The system SHALL display full context fields per queue item (change type, customer, summary, date, risk classification), support sort and filter, and send reviewer notifications on submission with configurable-threshold escalation.

nodes.title: Dashboard shows out-of-date information — an overdue item is not flagged to the clinician
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-057. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-113

nodes.title: Overcoded encounter urgent review queue with SLA and escalation
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface overcoded encounters detected by the quality monitoring cycle into a dedicated urgent review queue, with SLA timestamps and escalation notifications for unacknowledged items.

nodes.title: Non-admin users accessing private pricing and discount information
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-074. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-074

nodes.title: A false diagnosis code stays in a patient record and leads to wrong clinical decisions or unnecessary follow-up.
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-045. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-045

nodes.title: A combined task list could hide a backlog of safety-net alerts, delaying action
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Assertion context label and evidence display on SNOMED coding review card
nodes.description: The system SHALL display the assertion context label (present, negated, historical, family history, suspected), assertion confidence score, and triggering text window for each SNOMED coding proposal on the reviewer's coding card.

nodes.title: The AI tool misreads context in clinical notes (for example, treating a denied symptom as present)
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: An admin user creates harmful clinical rules that cause the AI tool to wrongly mark conditions as absent or suppress them entirely
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-012. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-012

nodes.title: Admin appointment details are saved as clinical findings in the patient record
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-054 and R-033 as possible merge (non-clinical text miscoded as finding). Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: A common GP abbreviation is matched to the wrong clinical code
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor - keep both but cross-link. R-055 is a high-severity subset of R-004.

nodes.title: The AI workflow applies a wrong clinical code change to a patient record
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-050 | Split out: FMEA-050 moved to new R-LEO-AI-160 per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: AI coding tool assigns a wrong clinical code without a clinician checking it first
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-058. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-058

nodes.title: A patient record shows an active care pathway when the condition is absent or historical
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-058. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-058

nodes.title: Active cancer investigation wrongly closed because an unrelated test result is misread by the AI tool
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | MERGED_IN: R-LEO-AI-061 (Cancer pathway incorrectly closed as completed after specialist letter when trea) per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: AI tool misreads 'No suicidal thoughts' and records the opposite meaning
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | MERGED_IN: R-LEO-AI-071 (ConText double-negation inverts assertion on polarity-encoding SNOMED finding co) per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: A junior trainee misunderstands unclear review screen labels and suppresses a real clinical finding
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-083 health-literacy overlap with R-081. Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: LLM semantic tag scope constraint to validated NER model output set
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that the LLM extraction step cannot introduce SNOMED semantic type labels that were not produced by the NER model for the same document; any additional semantic tags SHALL be detected and removed by the post-processing layer before the result is stored or returned.

nodes.title: Teaching examples stored with patient-identifying details
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-035. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-035

nodes.title: The AI tool incorrectly labels clinical information, adding a wrong clinical code to the patient record
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Data-gap detection and mandatory disclosure for clinician-facing outputs derived from incomplete data
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect when source data required to generate a clinician-facing output is partially or fully absent and SHALL either withhold the output or present it with a visible, plain-language data-gap warning that specifies the missing data fields; silent partial outputs without disclosure are prohibited.

nodes.title: Analysis of too few patients produces misleading results that a clinician acts on
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Software component record not kept up to date
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-084. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-135

nodes.title: Consistent async job API with documented lifecycle and webhooks
nodes.description: All long-running operations SHALL use the standard job resource pattern with documented status transitions, polling contract, and optional webhook delivery for terminal states.

nodes.title: Relation link persistence data model: typed tuples with confidence and multi-link support
nodes.description: The system SHALL persist relation links as typed, directed graph edges containing relation type, confidence score, extraction model version, timestamp, and assertion context, and SHALL permit multiple outgoing relations from a single source entity to support one-to-many finding-to-qualifier relationships.

nodes.title: Surface guideline treatment recommendations with comparable outcome summaries
nodes.description: The system SHALL present the active guideline's treatment recommendations for the pathway stage together with comparable-cohort outcome summaries and explicit data limitations in the clinician-facing view.

nodes.title: AI-generated clinical rule criteria may be wrong or incomplete
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-065. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-065

nodes.title: AI tool wrongly marks a cancer pathway as benign after a specialist appointment
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-063. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-063

nodes.title: Different dashboards show different waiting-time figures for the same patient episode
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | MERGED_IN: R-LEO-AI-092 (Different analytics endpoints using different 'confirmed cancer' filters give co) per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: Outdated treatment guideline shown to clinician
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-024. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Guideline staleness at point of clinical use - create R-LEO-AI-089

nodes.title: Treatment comparisons based on an unrepresentative group of patients
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-025. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Comparator bias risk - workshop priority

nodes.title: Plain-language coverage indicator explanation reachable in one action
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a plain-language explanation of each coverage indicator, reachable within one user action from the indicator itself, that describes what the coverage fraction represents, how it is calculated, and what the impact of a low score is for the output it accompanies.

nodes.title: A patient or clinician on a touch screen taps the wrong button because touch targets are too small
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A task needing urgent action is hidden from the clinician's view
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Episode classification method disclosure (rule-based vs LLM fallback) to reviewer
nodes.description: The system SHALL record for every episode classification whether the decision was produced by the rule-based primary classifier or the LLM fallback, and SHALL surface this information to the reviewer on the episode card so they can calibrate their review effort accordingly.

nodes.title: Patient database becomes unavailable, stopping the audit tool from working
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-010. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-010

nodes.title: Spinal level labels mistaken for cancer staging codes
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-039. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-039

nodes.title: The system fails to create a care episode when it should
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-011. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Missing episode (false negative) not explicitly covered - create R-LEO-AI-081

nodes.title: A patient visit is not classified and is left out of all care programmes
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-042. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-101 - detectability high concern

nodes.title: A quality problem in a patient episode is not caught by the checking rules
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-069. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-123

nodes.title: Quality check not run on some patient episodes
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-078. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-131

nodes.title: HITL gate: SNOMED coding proposals require individual reviewer decision before entering final audit data
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that no AI-generated SNOMED coding proposal can be written to the final audit dataset, exported, or consumed by any downstream product unless a qualified reviewer has individually accepted or rejected that proposal; this gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer and SHALL be immutably logged.

nodes.title: Reviewers stop checking AI suggestions carefully over time
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The AI tool infers a diagnosis from a lab result instead of recording the test value
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-080. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-080

nodes.title: AI-generated handover summary used without a clinician checking it first
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-031. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: adequate. HITL gap for SBAR - create R-LEO-AI-094

nodes.title: Human-readable API reference and versioned changelog co-published with each API release
nodes.description: The system SHALL co-publish a human-readable API reference and a versioned changelog alongside each machine-readable OpenAPI release, with version status markers enabling developers to identify current, stable, and deprecated versions.

nodes.title: Per-semantic-tag tier thresholds with extractor-confidence fusion
nodes.description: The tier classifier SHALL apply per-semantic-tag tier-1 and tier-2 score thresholds (e.g. disorder: 0.92/0.70, finding: 0.93/0.70, default: 0.95/0.70) and SHALL compute an effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence). Tier 1 SHALL additionally require extractor_confidence >= 0.80 (TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR). Entities where assertion_parity_failed or disorder_verdict == GATE_FAILED SHALL be demoted to tier 2 regardless of effective_score.

nodes.title: MDT case summary template with pathway checklist and comparators
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate an MDT summary covering mandatory pathway checklist items and comparable prior MDT decisions for similar cases, with explicit gaps where data are missing.

nodes.title: The AI tool takes staging information from the wrong cancer pathway on the same patient
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI tool produces an incomplete or wrong summary for a multidisciplinary team meeting
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-030. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-093

nodes.title: Reviewer self-approval prevention and administrator-only credential profile management with full audit logging
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce reviewer self-approval prevention at the API layer, restrict credential profile management to the administrator role, and audit log all credential assignments and changes.

nodes.title: A clinician reviews or approves their own work without this being detected
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-049. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-106

nodes.title: Programme-level configuration of completeness and suppression thresholds
nodes.description: The system SHALL store all data completeness thresholds, cohort minimum sizes, and data-gap warning floor values as named programme-level configuration parameters that can be changed by an administrator without code deployment; all changes SHALL be audit logged.

nodes.title: A whole clinical area is coded wrongly, hiding problems in patient care pathways
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Wrong setup of an audit programme causes the AI workflow to process patient data incorrectly
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-068 FMEA-075. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-068 FMEA-075

nodes.title: Wrong cancer stage recorded at diagnosis
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Alert incorrectly suppressed because a clinical response code was recorded in error
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-015. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Incorrect suppression scenario not covered - create R-LEO-AI-083

nodes.title: Clinical significance framing: interpretation content bounded to structured input facts
nodes.description: The system SHALL verify that every generated interpretation contains only clinical statements that are directly supported by the structured coded findings passed as input, and SHALL reject any interpretation that introduces clinical facts not present in the structured input set.

nodes.title: Hidden instructions in patient notes cause the AI to produce wrong clinical codes
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Missing or wrong links between clinical findings lead to incorrect coding suggestions
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-014. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-014

nodes.title: The system removes too much clinical detail when hiding patient identifiers
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-013. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Over-redaction not covered - create R-LEO-AI-082

nodes.title: AI tool gives an inaccurate or misleading interpretation of a clinical finding
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-033. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-096

nodes.title: Structured override taxonomy capture on every coding correction
nodes.description: The review UI SHALL require a structured error category and optional free text when a user overrides an AI coding proposal, and SHALL store both with the audit record.

nodes.title: Override reason recorded in the wrong category
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-038. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-099

nodes.title: ODS change report four-type classification (new, retired, successor, merger/split) with effective dates
nodes.description: The system SHALL classify ODS changes in the weekly sync report into four distinct types (new, retired, successor assignment, merger/split), each with effective date and successor code, to enable targeted resolution by type.

nodes.title: Patient record corrupted by an admin using the data-correction tool
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-063. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-063

nodes.title: Persona lens control reframing workspace language for different user roles without changing analysis
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a persona lens control on the research workspace that reframes mission titles, scoping questions, and result language for different user roles without altering the underlying analysis or data.

nodes.title: Research results shown without warning about incomplete data
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-072. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-126

nodes.title: Model improvement cycle with active learning, metrics, golden gate, and warm start
nodes.description: The training orchestration SHALL prioritise labelling candidates via the configured active learning policy, compute per-entity F1 on the frozen golden set, block promotion when below threshold, and support warm-start from the last promoted model artifact.

nodes.title: Hidden instructions in patient notes cause the AI tool to give wrong clinical codes
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-012. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-012

nodes.title: An auditor approves a cancer episode containing wrong AI-generated data, leading to flawed clinical decisions
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-008 FMEA-037 | Data fix: FMEA-037 re-routed to R-LEO-AI-053 per Dedup Auditor | Split out: FMEA-008 moved to new R-LEO-AI-159 per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: NICE structured assessment prompt with mandatory obligation detection and 'not applicable' rationale recording
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate structured NICE assessment prompts covering all four mandatory fields, automatically create time-bound change requests for mandatory obligations, and allow 'not applicable' recording with documented rationale without triggering a change request.

nodes.title: Clinical decision submitted without a recorded reason
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-053. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-110

nodes.title: DQ engine: configurable rules with per-episode persistence of pass/fail and remediation recommendation
nodes.description: The system SHALL evaluate each processed episode against a configurable DQ rule set covering completeness, coding consistency, terminology currency, and duplicate detection, persisting per-episode, per-rule results with pass/fail status and a remediation recommendation, with new rules addable via configuration.

nodes.title: Guideline compliance checker gives wrong alerts about care quality
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Patient information sent to external AI services without confirmed data agreements
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-089. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-089

nodes.title: A clinician or trainee misreads the operations screen and either misses a quality alert or starts a live deployment too early.
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | MERGED_IN: R-LEO-AI-088 (A junior staff member or older clinician misreads the Care Overview page and eit) per Dedup Auditor

nodes.title: Override analytics dashboard with category distribution, trends, and reviewer role breakdown
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide an override analytics dashboard showing override rate, error category distribution, time trend, and reviewer role breakdown, with filterable CSV export for model improvement analysis.

nodes.title: Partial job result surfacing per completed pipeline step before overall job completion
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface partial job results via the status endpoint as each pipeline step completes, allowing consuming products to process available data without waiting for full job completion.

nodes.title: Information is lost when the AI workflow passes data between steps
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI reading service unavailable, stopping patient record processing
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: System fails to show the clinician the escalation threshold when reviewing a test result
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-022. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. No risk on guideline threshold surfacing failure - create R-LEO-AI-088

nodes.title: End-to-end relation link integrity through the full processing pipeline
nodes.description: The system SHALL guarantee that every relation link created at extraction is preserved without modification or silent loss through every subsequent pipeline stage, from extraction through review, training feedback, inference, and audit trail storage; any discrepancy SHALL trigger an alert and halt the affected pipeline.

nodes.title: Programme configuration hot-reload: changes take effect at next run without service restart
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply programme configuration changes without a service restart or deployment; changes SHALL take effect at the start of the next pipeline run for the affected programme.

nodes.title: NICE catalogue: domain taxonomy classification and three-state coverage status against active pathway rules
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically classify each ingested NICE publication against the active domain taxonomy and assign a coverage status of rule-covered, change-request-open, or no-coverage, updating this status automatically as linked pathway rules and change requests are created or resolved.

nodes.title: Updated clinical rules may not take effect after an administrator approves them
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Wrong clinical codes from AI tool could spread errors across multiple care pathway checks
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A silent change to the NICE guidelines list could leave clinicians unable to browse guidelines by clinical area
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-009 FMEA-061 FMEA-064. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-009 FMEA-061 FMEA-064

nodes.title: NICE ingest: scheduled automated ingestion via NICE API into structured knowledge graph nodes
nodes.description: The system SHALL ingest NICE publications from the NICE API on a configurable automated schedule, storing each as a structured knowledge graph node with publication type, guideline number, version, publication date, pathway tags, and source URL, alerting the content manager on ingestion failure.

nodes.title: Patient record exports may include staff email addresses
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Knowledge base currency dashboard with exportable surveillance evidence
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a consolidated dashboard listing last verification, next review due date, and status for every active guideline and reference dataset, and SHALL export the same snapshot for post-market surveillance records.

nodes.title: Audit trail 10-year retention enforcement with platform version recording and summary report by date range
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a minimum 10-year audit trail retention with a non-reducible configuration floor, record platform version on every event, and provide a summary report API by date range.

nodes.title: A clinical decision is made but no record of it is saved
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-055. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-111

nodes.title: Stable JSON error envelope with machine-readable error codes
nodes.description: All error responses SHALL return the standard JSON envelope with HTTP status, machine-readable error code, human-readable message, correlation identifier, and optional detail object.

nodes.title: Clinician makes an accidental or missed action in the coding review screen due to unclear warnings, hidden errors, or access barriers
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-006. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-006

nodes.title: System error message reveals internal technical detail to the user
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-090. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower priority

nodes.title: Continuous coding quality metrics with regression alerting
nodes.description: The operations service SHALL compute rolling coding quality metrics on scheduled samples and SHALL raise alerts when any metric crosses configured regression thresholds.

nodes.title: Organisation data becomes out of date when the nightly update fails without raising an alert
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A drop in coding accuracy goes unnoticed for several weeks, letting incorrect patient records build up.
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-079. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-079

nodes.title: Too many false alerts cause staff to ignore them, so a real coding failure goes unnoticed.
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-016 FMEA-045. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-016 FMEA-045

nodes.title: An old specialist visit is wrongly linked to a new referral, making an active pathway look finished
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI quality check removes correct clinical findings or adds ones not supported by the notes
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-007 FMEA-020. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-007 FMEA-020 | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-068 and R-067 as possible merge (same hazard, different pipeline stage). Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: AI tool wrongly labels a diagnosis appointment as a referral, making the wait time look near-zero
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: New AI model version not stopped when accuracy drops
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-043. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-102

nodes.title: Triage view: visually distinct labelled panels, cohort filter by age/symptom/source, single-view completion
nodes.description: The system SHALL visually distinguish guideline and cohort panels with informational labelling, support cohort filtering by age band, presenting symptom, and referral source, and enable triage completion within the single view.

nodes.title: Wrong pathway eligibility rules shown to the clinician
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-029. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-092

nodes.title: Trajectory deviation prompts require structured documented clinician response, not dismissal
nodes.description: The system SHALL require documented clinician acknowledgement (structured response action) for trajectory deviation prompts, not just dismissal, and SHALL store the response in the audit trail.

nodes.title: Absolute character-offset resolver for LLM-extracted entities
nodes.description: The extraction pipeline SHALL resolve absolute character offsets (span_start, span_end) for every LLM-extracted entity against the original encounter text, honouring sentence boundaries and repeated mentions, so that every extracted entity has immutable provenance back to its source phrase.

nodes.title: The AI tool wrongly codes treatment plans or safety-netting advice as confirmed clinical findings
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-054 and R-033 as possible merge (non-clinical text miscoded as finding). Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: DQ sitrep dashboard: pass rate aggregation by rule/programme/tenant with trend and CSV export
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a DQ sitrep dashboard aggregating pass rates per rule, per programme, and per tenant with trend over time, supporting targeted remediation pass execution per rule/programme, and enabling CSV export for post-market surveillance governance evidence.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking audit reporting use of unreviewed episode classifications
nodes.description: The system SHALL prevent any episode classification from being included in an audit report or exported for downstream use unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision on that episode; the enforcement SHALL occur at the data query layer and SHALL be logged.

nodes.title: Screen animations cause dizziness or nausea in clinicians with balance disorders
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The AI tool that merges duplicate episodes could wrongly combine two separate primary cancers into one record
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Automated quality checks miss incorrectly coded clinical entries
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-008. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: gap. Split from R-LEO-AI-065 per Dedup Auditor - different control layer (automated rule vs human auditor approval).

nodes.title: Population pathway dashboards with national benchmark overlays
nodes.description: The analytics service SHALL provide dashboards of population pathway metrics with national benchmark series, drill-down filters, and exportable definitions for each figure.

nodes.title: Wrong milestone dates cause incorrect waiting time calculations
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-073. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-073

nodes.title: The dashboard undercounts cancer diagnoses that came through the two-week-wait (2WW) referral route, making the figure look far lower than it should be
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The system shows a clinician an incorrect benchmark comparison
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-070. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-124

nodes.title: Dashboard counts the wrong group of patients as its baseline population
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-076. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-129

nodes.title: Wrong patients included in or excluded from a care cohort
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-081. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-133

nodes.title: Patient record saved without a source label
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-092. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-139

nodes.title: Research workspace single-action structured export with method metadata and no patient identifiers
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a single-action structured file export from the research workspace results panel, including result data, scoping parameters, analysis method identifier, and coverage indicator, with no patient identifiers in the export.

nodes.title: Confidence level displayed alongside each AI-generated interpretation
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a confidence level in every generated plain-language interpretation, derived from the confidence scores of the underlying extracted entities, presented as both a numeric value and a human-readable tier label visible to the reviewer alongside the interpretation text.

nodes.title: Patient-identifying details not removed from clinical notes before the AI tool reads them
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The system shows the wrong stage of a patient's care pathway
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-028. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-091

nodes.title: A patient visit is assigned to the wrong audit programme
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-041. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-100

nodes.title: Isolated test credential environment with per-scope credentials and full OAuth 2.0/OIDC flow support
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a test credential environment isolated from production patient data, supporting the full OAuth 2.0/OIDC auth flow with one test credential per scope, and covered by the sandbox version-alignment lag policy.

nodes.title: Guidance rule extraction: AI-generated structured candidates with source section reference and prompt version
nodes.description: The system SHALL accept a guideline document section as input and produce a structured list of candidate pathway rules, each containing condition, action, population scope, evidence grade, and a direct reference to the source guideline section, executed as an async job with the LLM prompt version recorded on each candidate.

nodes.title: Diagnostic and treatment recommendation exclusion from generated interpretations
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply a post-generation content classification check to every AI-generated interpretation that detects and blocks outputs containing diagnostic conclusions, differential diagnoses, or treatment recommendations before the output is presented to any user or API consumer.

nodes.title: Mission Control: per-programme per-tenant pipeline KPI dashboard with auto-refresh
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide an operational dashboard displaying per-programme, per-tenant pipeline KPIs including encounter queue depth, processing success/failure rate, episode build status, and last completed run timestamp, refreshing automatically on a configurable interval and surfacing no patient-identifiable data.

nodes.title: Failed patient encounters not shown to clinical staff
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-077. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-130 - detectability concern

nodes.title: Configurable single-vs-dual-model LLM consensus runner
nodes.description: The consensus runner used by the disorder gate and coding-verifier steps SHALL support two modes: (1) single-model (default) - one AWS Bedrock call at the configured tier with a strict-reminder parse-retry on parse failure; (2) dual-model (opt-in via CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) - AWS small-tier and Azure small-tier judges run in parallel, an AWS big-tier arbitrator resolves disagreement or single-provider failure. The runner SHALL fail-closed by returning the caller-supplied fail_verdict when all providers fail.

nodes.title: A reviewer picks the wrong clinical code when correcting a patient record
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-050. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: gap. Split from R-LEO-AI-056 per Dedup Auditor - R-056 is automated dual-LLM remediation; this is human reviewer expertise gap.

nodes.title: LLM extractor emits self-rated assertion and confidence per entity
nodes.description: The LLM extractor SHALL emit a self-rated assertion label (present | absent | uncertain | historical | family_history | conditional | hypothetical) and a self-rated confidence score in [0.0, 1.0] for every extracted entity. Values SHALL be parsed, normalised, and clamped, and SHALL be written onto each ExtractedTerm / ExtractionItem for use by downstream tiering and parity checks.

nodes.title: Episode timeline generation with pathway gap highlighting
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate a timeline view for every constructed episode, showing each constituent encounter as a dated node with its associated pathway milestone and coded entities, with pathway sequence gaps visually highlighted.

nodes.title: SBAR summary misses safety netting alerts
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-032. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Dependency on safety netting - create R-LEO-AI-095

nodes.title: Reversible de-identification placeholder substitution with in-memory session mapping
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement reversible placeholder substitution for patient identifiers, replacing each detected identifier with a typed placeholder token and restoring original values from an in-memory session mapping when processing LLM responses.

nodes.title: Structured approval capture with immutable audit and deploy interlock
nodes.description: Approval actions SHALL require mandatory rationale fields, write append-only audit records, and SHALL bind deployment jobs to the approval identifier.

nodes.title: Referral triage view with eligibility rules and comparable outcomes
nodes.description: The referral workspace SHALL display pathway eligibility criteria and comparable anonymised outcomes for similar referrals at decision time.

nodes.title: Fixing a wrong clinical code link stops future errors but leaves past patient records with the wrong code.
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A condition recorded as absent is wrongly counted as present in a patient's risk score or care group
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: SNOMED CT release diff with blocking resolution workflow
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute diffs for each SNOMED CT import against the active dictionary and SHALL block activation until every blocking item has a disposition record.

nodes.title: A routine clinical coding update breaks how the AI tool matches terms to clinical codes
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: CI-enforced code quality gates: black, flake8, ESLint with function and file length limits
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce automated code quality checks in CI: black formatting and flake8 linting for Python, ESLint for TypeScript, with function and file length limits; any violation blocks the merge pipeline.

nodes.title: FHIR: capability statement at /fhir/metadata and CI FHIR validator against UK Core profiles
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish a FHIR capability statement at GET /fhir/metadata, and SHALL run the FHIR validator against all generated FHIR resources as a blocking CI step, validating conformance against UK Core profiles for Observation and EpisodeOfCare.

nodes.title: A patient data message in the wrong format breaks a clinical system that relies on it
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-091. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-138

nodes.title: Machine-readable OpenAPI for every public API version
nodes.description: The platform SHALL publish a complete OpenAPI document for each supported API major.minor version before that version is marked generally available.

nodes.title: Cohort builder: rule-based inclusion/exclusion across coded entities, pathway stage, and demographics
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a cohort builder interface accepting inclusion/exclusion rules over SNOMED coded entities, pathway stages, demographic attributes (age band, sex, IMD decile), and episode attributes, combining rules with AND/OR logic and displaying the matching patient count before the cohort is saved.

nodes.title: Patient list version not recorded when the AI runs
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-082. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-134 - reproducibility risk

nodes.title: Present investigation escalation thresholds and comparable cohort trajectories
nodes.description: The system SHALL display guideline-defined investigation escalation thresholds and comparable population trajectories for the active pathway context whenever a user views investigation results for triage or follow-up.

nodes.title: Guideline evaluation completion within 5 seconds per patient at p95
nodes.description: The system SHALL complete guideline evaluation for a single patient and make resulting alerts available in the reviewer queue within 5 seconds at p95 latency under nominal and defined peak load conditions.

nodes.title: Low-confidence entity flagging and intra-episode coding contradiction detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface low-confidence NLP entity classifications and coding contradictions within each episode as quality flags, visible before the episode is used in any reporting or downstream product.

nodes.title: A rule set too broadly stops a clinical term from being coded at all
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Guidance rule review queue: per-candidate mandatory decision with bidirectional provenance links on promotion
nodes.description: The system SHALL present extracted candidate rules in a review queue requiring a per-candidate decision of accept, reject, or edit with mandatory rationale, blocking promotion until all candidates have a decision, and SHALL create bidirectional links from promoted rules to their source guideline entry and any superseded rules.

nodes.title: Saved links to the clinical admin page stop working after the page is moved
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Clinic list preparation view with pathway status and comparators
nodes.description: The clinic preparation view SHALL list outstanding pathway actions, current stage versus targets, and anonymised comparators for similar patients at the same stage.

nodes.title: Mission Control: failed encounter list with failure reason and one-click re-queue
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface failed and stalled encounters in the operations dashboard with failure reason, failure timestamp, and programme, providing a one-click re-queue action per encounter with the re-queue event written to the audit trail including operator identity.

nodes.title: A user from one organisation can see patient records belonging to another organisation
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Patient details leak into AI teaching files, causing a data breach.
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Persistent informational-only disclaimer on all clinician-facing clinical intelligence output panels
nodes.description: The system SHALL render a persistent 'informational signposting only' disclaimer on every clinician-facing clinical intelligence output panel, drawn from configurable text.

nodes.title: Semantic versioning policy with published deprecation notices
nodes.description: The platform SHALL publish and follow semantic versioning for public APIs, announce deprecations with at least the minimum notice period, and maintain a compatibility matrix per release.

nodes.title: A software update silently changes how the system works, breaking connected systems
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-085. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Create R-LEO-AI-136

nodes.title: Data-driven audit programme configuration without deployment
nodes.description: New audit programmes SHALL be creatable by authoring graph configuration and workflow bindings through the admin interface without a software deployment.

nodes.title: Safety-net system fails to flag patients who may have cancer and need follow-up
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI audit tool enters a runaway loop and generates unexpected cloud computing costs
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: AI quality check wrongly removes correct clinical codes or sends too many for manual review
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-068 and R-067 as possible merge (same hazard, different pipeline stage). Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: Per-entity-type precision/recall/F1 metrics stored per training job and accessible via model registry
nodes.description: The system SHALL produce and store per-entity-type precision/recall/F1 metrics for every training job, linked to the training job ID, accessible via the model registry API and UI without aggregation.

nodes.title: Safety check wrongly stops a good AI model update
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-044. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: adequate. Lower priority - workshop: acceptable?

nodes.title: Audit quality loops: per-entity-type coding frequency drift detection with configurable threshold
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute the coding frequency distribution per entity type per programme at each audit period boundary, compare consecutive period distributions, and generate an alert when the delta for any entity type exceeds the configurable drift threshold.

nodes.title: Test patient records used during AI training, making accuracy results misleading and hiding true performance.
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: FMEA-037. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk | Added FMEA link: FMEA-037 (holdout leakage)

nodes.title: Assertion parity check between LLM extractor and ConText post-processing
nodes.description: The post-processing stack SHALL compare the LLM extractor's self-rated assertion (snapshotted at the start of post-processing) with the final assertion determined by ConText and situation-lookup layers, and SHALL set an assertion_parity_failed flag on the entity when they differ. Entities with assertion_parity_failed=true SHALL NOT be eligible for tier 1 auto-coding regardless of terminology score.

nodes.title: ConText rule change: pre-save assertion distribution impact report against held-out corpus
nodes.description: The system SHALL compute the assertion distribution impact of a proposed ConText rule change against the held-out test corpus before the change is saved, displaying the delta in assertion type counts relative to the current active rule set and storing the impact report with the change record.

nodes.title: Active evidence engagement gate before AI recommendation confirmation with urgency-criterion requirement
nodes.description: The system SHALL render the AI recommendation confirm button as disabled until a reviewer has performed the configured minimum active evidence engagement actions, with high-urgency recommendations requiring explicit confirmation of the primary urgency criterion.

nodes.title: Guideline monitoring registry under clinical change control with full alert context and escalation
nodes.description: The system SHALL subject the guideline monitoring registry to the same change control and version control as clinical content, and SHALL include full alert context (source, date, scope, link) with automatic escalation for unacknowledged alerts.

nodes.title: Safety netting: configurable follow-up time window with worklist of outstanding flagged findings
nodes.description: The system SHALL maintain a safety netting worklist containing all findings classified as borderline or critical where no coded clinical response has been recorded within a configurable time window, surfacing each entry with patient identifier, finding type, severity band, result date, and days outstanding.

nodes.title: A test result given as a word rather than a number is not recognised by the AI tool, so abnormal findings are not flagged on the dashboard
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A patient, carer, or junior staff member acts on a screen they do not fully understand because no plain-English explanation is shown, leading to a wrong or missed action
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor flagged R-083 health-literacy overlap with R-081. Medium confidence - retain both.

nodes.title: Safety-net alerts are generated but not shown on the worklist, or marking an alert as actioned appears to work but saves nothing
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Switching role mid-task loses unsaved safety-critical information
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Global active training job indicator visible from all admin pages
nodes.description: The system SHALL display a persistent, globally-visible training job status indicator on every admin page while a training job is running, navigating to the job detail view on click.

nodes.title: The screen shows an out-of-date AI processing status to the clinician
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-071. Workshop decision: adjust. Control adequacy: partial. Create R-LEO-AI-125

nodes.title: Automated guideline conformance evaluation on coded encounters
nodes.description: The quality engine SHALL evaluate each coded encounter against the active programme rule set, emit severity-scored deviation alerts, and route them to the review queue.

nodes.title: A single reviewer approves a wrong clinical code for a common phrase, causing every future patient record with that phrase to be coded incorrectly.
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-046. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-046

nodes.title: Span realignment and offset validation on training export with misaligned annotation exclusion
nodes.description: The system SHALL apply span realignment to every annotation in a training export, recomputing character offsets from surface text, and SHALL exclude misaligned annotations from the export with a structured log entry.

nodes.title: RBAC enforcement for all AI output review and finalisation actions
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce role-based access control for all AI output review and finalisation actions, ensuring that no AI-generated entity, episode classification, quality alert, or clinical interpretation can be accepted, edited, or rejected without a user who has an appropriate assigned role performing the action.

nodes.title: Conditional approval condition list with per-condition confirmation tracking and deployment gate enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL require conditional approvals to include at least one named condition, track each condition's confirmation state individually, and block deployment until all conditions are confirmed.

nodes.title: API audit log endpoint with per-credential time-bounded query and minimum 10-year retention
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose a time-bounded audit log API endpoint that returns all API calls made by a given product credential, retained for a minimum of 10 years, with access restricted to the credential owner and authorised Mizaic personnel.

nodes.title: Active SNOMED CT version endpoint for downstream integrator technical file documentation
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose the active SNOMED CT UK Edition version via a dedicated API endpoint for use in downstream integrators' technical files, updated automatically when a new release is activated.

nodes.title: Weekly ODS synchronisation with blocking resolutions for breaking changes
nodes.description: The reference data service SHALL import ODS deltas weekly, flag breaking changes, and block downstream use of retired organisation codes until each is resolved or remapped.

nodes.title: Exportable tamper-evident review decision ledger
nodes.description: The system SHALL maintain an append-only ledger of review decisions with hash chaining and SHALL export the full ledger with verification instructions for third-party inspection.

nodes.title: Job status responses include elapsed time, estimated completion, current step name, and support cancellation
nodes.description: The system SHALL include elapsed time, estimated completion time (where calculable), and current pipeline step name in job status responses, and SHALL support job cancellation with confirmed outcome via the status model.

nodes.title: LLM fallback method labelling and threshold configuration for NER coding proposals
nodes.description: The system SHALL label every NER-extracted entity with a machine-readable extraction method field (ner_primary, ner_with_llm_fallback, llm_only) and SHALL surface this label prominently on the reviewer's coding card; the LLM fallback threshold SHALL be configurable per programme.

nodes.title: Authoritative source change detection with routed alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL monitor configured authoritative sources for updates, match them to affected pathways, and create routed alerts with direct links to source artefacts.

nodes.title: Per-tenant AI usage accounting and configurable commercial rates
nodes.description: The billing console SHALL aggregate token or call usage per tenant, apply configurable rates and discounts, and separate platform operating costs from billable usage in exported reports.

nodes.title: Multi-level pathway metrics aggregation at organisation, PCN, and ICB with ODS-sourced hierarchy
nodes.description: The system SHALL aggregate pathway interval metrics and breach rates at organisation (ODS), PCN, and ICB levels using a configurable hierarchy sourced from ODS reference data, with RBAC-controlled access to each aggregation tier.

nodes.title: The system shall keep test patients in the same shape as real patients, with a clear test marker, so the AI tools read them the same way
nodes.description: The system SHALL store every test patient in the patient database with the same structure as a real patient (encounters, documents, observations, values, units, clinical codes, pathway state). Every test patient SHALL be marked clearly as a test record by carrying a separate test patient label and an is_test = true flag. Every test patient SHALL also carry a tag saying which part of the AI it is for: reading notes, building the patient story, checking guideline rules, or writing the SBAR handover. The system SHALL offer a copy-a-real-patient-and-de-identify action that takes a real patient, copies the structure under a new test record, removes all identifying details (NHS number, name, date of birth, address, phone numbers), and puts test_ in front of the display name. Lists, dashboards and exports that show real patients SHALL never include test patients.

nodes.title: A test patient is mistaken for a real patient and shows up in a clinician worklist or an audit report
nodes.description: The patient database holds both real and test patients. If any read query forgets to filter out test records, a fictional patient could leak into a clinical surface or an audit export, wasting clinician time or, in the worst case, leading to a clinical decision based on synthetic data.
nodes.reviewCandidateReason: Risk analysis complete; control review required.

nodes.title: Cross-graph copy from a real patient leaks identifying details into the knowledge database
nodes.description: The new copy-from-real test patient flow reads from the real patient database and writes to the knowledge database. If free text on the source (clinic notes, document body) carries identifying details and the redaction step is skipped, fails silently, or misses a pattern, those details land in the knowledge database where the test patient library lives.
nodes.reviewCandidateReason: Risk analysis complete; control review required.

nodes.title: Physical separation of patient data and terminology data into distinct database instances
nodes.description: The system SHALL store patient clinical data and clinical terminology data in physically separate database instances with separate credentials, with no direct database-level connections between them, so that a compromise or failure of the terminology database cannot expose or corrupt patient data.

nodes.title: Patient details accidentally saved into the clinical codes database
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: A reviewer approves a wrong clinical code that then influences future coding suggestions
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Real patient data copied into the test environment
nodes.description: Source: FMEA_GAP. FMEA refs: FMEA-088. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: adequate. Low probability - note at workshop

nodes.title: Coding correction review with dependency and terminology validation
nodes.description: The reviewer workflow SHALL show downstream dependents of a proposed code change and SHALL run terminology validation rules before approval is permitted.

nodes.title: A known security weakness in a third-party software component could be exploited
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: gap. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: The AI codes clinical information automatically, with no clinician check before saving
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: escalate_class_C. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Auto-correction picks the wrong clinical code for a term
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Safety gate: SNOMED coding defects in training labels always routed to human review, never auto-corrected
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that SNOMED coding defects in training labels are never auto-corrected by the audit agent; they SHALL always be routed to the human review queue, while non-SNOMED defects in the safe-fix rule set may be auto-corrected.

nodes.title: AI tool suggests wrong clinical code, which could enter the teaching examples used to train the system
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-036. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-036

nodes.title: SBAR: AI-generated structured summary from coded encounters, pathway stage, and safety netting alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate an SBAR-structured clinical summary for a patient by synthesising their coded encounters, current pathway stage, and any outstanding safety netting alerts, using the active LLM prompt for summary generation and labelling all content as AI-generated.

nodes.title: Clinicians using assistive technology cannot tell where they are in the system or read status alerts correctly
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: adequate. Existing YAML risk

nodes.title: Guideline update review: side-by-side version comparison with source navigation and affected rules enumeration
nodes.description: The system SHALL present a side-by-side version comparison view for guideline updates, display the source reference with a navigable link, and enumerate all pathway rules and decision logic affected by the update within the review workflow.

nodes.title: Mandatory clinical impact assessment section before approval
nodes.description: The review workflow SHALL require completion of the structured clinical impact questionnaire and SHALL block approval until all mandatory impact questions are answered.

nodes.title: Ranked patient shortlist with fused relevance score and supporting evidence spans
nodes.description: The system SHALL return patient shortlists as ranked results with a fused relevance score, supporting evidence spans, and programme coverage estimate for each candidate, displayed to the reviewer on the shortlisting results screen.

nodes.title: Immutable source-span linkage and provenance for extracted entities
nodes.description: Each AI-extracted entity SHALL store the exact source text span, model or rule identifier, confidence, assertion context, and an integrity hash that rejects post-hoc edits.

nodes.title: IMD deprivation analysis panel for pathway performance with health equity monitoring support
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a deprivation analysis panel segmenting pathway performance by IMD decile, with consistent filtering and cited data sources, to support health equity monitoring.

nodes.title: Per-relation-type quality gates and metrics for relation model promotion
nodes.description: The system SHALL produce per-relation-type precision, recall, and F1 metrics for every relation model training run and SHALL enforce a configurable quality gate that blocks promotion of any model that fails the threshold on any supported relation type.

nodes.title: Episode quality gate: flagged episodes blocked from reporting until flags are resolved
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a quality gate that prevents any episode with unresolved quality flags from being included in a reporting dataset or exported until a reviewer has explicitly resolved each flag, with all resolutions immutably audit-logged.

nodes.title: Sandbox version-alignment with production within documented lag window and synthetic-only patient data guarantee
nodes.description: The system SHALL keep the sandbox version-aligned with production within a documented lag window, surface version-lag state via API header, and guarantee all sandbox patient data is synthetic with no real NHS identifiers.

nodes.title: Unified LangGraph coding agent as the single execution path for all coding and pipeline jobs
nodes.description: The system SHALL use a single unified LangGraph-based coding and audit agent as the exclusive runtime execution path for all clinical coding and pipeline jobs, with the training and runtime pipelines sharing the same post-processing functions, so that there is no divergence between paths and all coding outputs are traceable to a single versioned agent definition.

nodes.title: Multi-tenancy: tenant token validation before query execution with architecturally enforced single-driver scoping
