nodes.description: The system SHALL validate the tenant context token on every API request before any Cypher query executes, return a 401 for missing or invalid tokens, and construct all Cypher query builders to accept only a single driver connection scoped to the requesting tenant, with cross-tenant access verified as architecturally impossible by automated test.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking publication of AI-generated interpretations without reviewer decision
nodes.description: The system SHALL prevent any AI-generated plain-language interpretation from being published, shared, exported, or surfaced to a downstream consumer unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit accept or reject decision against that specific interpretation; the gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer, not only in the UI.

nodes.title: Published integrator documentation and auditable API interactions
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish versioned integration documentation and SHALL record sufficient API-level audit metadata for integrators to trace requests, job identifiers, and principal outcomes for inclusion in a downstream technical file.

nodes.title: Content currency gate: marking as current requires linked verification event; automatic overdue transition by type-specific interval
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce that content components can only be marked as current via a recorded verification event linked to an authoritative source reference, and SHALL automatically transition components to 'overdue' when their type-specific review interval is exceeded.

nodes.title: Clinical qualifier preservation in LLM extraction for SNOMED specificity
nodes.description: The LLM extraction prompt (extraction_v1) SHALL instruct the model to preserve clinical qualifiers - laterality, severity, acuity, episodicity, morphology, anatomical site, and temporal qualifiers - in the extracted term text and in the lookup_term field used for SNOMED terminology retrieval. Qualifiers SHALL NOT be stripped to a canonical headword when the source narrative contains them.

nodes.title: Wrong clinical code assigned by the AI tool that reads notes
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-001. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-001

nodes.title: The AI tool picks the wrong clinical code when several codes could match
nodes.description: Source: YAML. FMEA refs: n/a. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Existing YAML risk | Workshop flag: Dedup Auditor - keep both but cross-link. R-055 is a high-severity subset of R-004.

nodes.title: Safety netting: immutable action recording with clinician identity and timestamp
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow a clinician to record, amend, and close a safety netting action against any flagged finding, writing the action type, free-text note, clinician identity, and timestamp immutably to the audit trail, with amendments creating a new audit record rather than overwriting the prior entry.

nodes.title: Episode temporal quality checks: duration outliers, missing milestones, and sequence anomaly detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect and flag episode duration outliers, missing mandatory milestones, and temporal anomalies in milestone event sequences against configurable programme-level thresholds.

nodes.title: Benchmark chart rendering: three-state colour scheme, delta labels, WCAG 2.1 AA compliance, human-readable labels
nodes.description: The system SHALL render benchmark comparison charts with a three-state colour scheme plus delta labels, WCAG 2.1 AA compliant colours, and human-readable programme labels drawn from configuration.

nodes.title: SNOMED coding accuracy quality gate: minimum F1 0.85 on gold-standard dataset
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure NER-to-SNOMED coding accuracy as F1 on a frozen gold-standard dataset at each model release and SHALL enforce a minimum F1 quality gate of 0.85 that blocks production promotion of any coding model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: Investigation ordering assistance with guideline norms and comparators
nodes.description: The ordering view SHALL show guideline-recommended investigations for the pathway stage and anonymised ordering frequencies for comparable patients.

nodes.title: Neutral unranked treatment option display with cohort disclosure and lay-readable consultation mode
nodes.description: The system SHALL display treatment options in a neutral, unranked presentation with cohort match criteria and data source disclosed, and SHALL provide a lay-readable rendering mode for use during patient-facing consultations.

nodes.title: Historical code frequency display on coding correction review page
nodes.description: The system SHALL display the historical frequency of the original code in the active patient dataset on the coding correction review page, showing counts for the last 12 months and the full historical period, to enable the reviewer to assess the potential scope of impact.

nodes.title: Assertion evidence text context stored alongside assertion label
nodes.description: The system SHALL store alongside each assertion label the verbatim text window that the assertion model evaluated to determine that label, so that a reviewer can read the textual evidence for the assertion without needing to re-read the full source document.

nodes.title: MDT summary AI-content labelling, pre-submission editability, and edit delta record preserving AI original
nodes.description: The system SHALL label all AI-generated MDT summary content with visible badges, allow full pre-submission editing of all fields, and store clinician edits as a separate delta record preserving both the original AI-generated and final clinician-reviewed text.

nodes.title: Encounter classification: misclassification labelling feedback loop and model registry integration
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow misclassified encounters to be flagged as labelled training examples directly from the classification review interface, add them to the training corpus, and manage the classification model version through the model registry with the same canary promotion workflow applied to the NER model.

nodes.title: Unified review queue for all AI proposal types with reviewer corrections stored as structured training data
nodes.description: The system SHALL present all AI-generated proposals in a unified role-based review queue grouped by type, and SHALL store reviewer corrections as structured training data linked to the original proposal for use in the model improvement cycle.

nodes.title: Pre-application customer notification for attribution-affecting ODS changes and historical mapping retention
nodes.description: The system SHALL notify affected customers before applying ODS changes that affect patient pathway attribution, and SHALL maintain an immutable historical ODS mapping record enabling accurate retrospective pathway attribution queries.

nodes.title: SBAR: mandatory human review gate before finalisation with AI-original/edit delta record
nodes.description: The system SHALL require a clinician review step before an SBAR summary is marked as finalised, and SHALL record any edits made during review as a structured delta preserving the original AI-generated text alongside the edited text, with the editor identity and timestamp.

nodes.title: NLP surface form dependency display in coding correction review
nodes.description: The system SHALL display on the coding correction review page all NLP surface form strings currently mapped to the original code, including their match type and historical frequency, so the reviewer can identify surface form mapping dependencies that would need to be updated if the correction is approved.

nodes.title: HITL gate: pathway interval calculations use only reviewer-accepted milestone data
nodes.description: The system SHALL ensure all pathway interval calculations and breach assessments are performed exclusively on milestone data that has been accepted by a qualified reviewer, and SHALL return a pending status rather than provisional metrics for episodes with any unreviewed milestones.

nodes.title: Reference ranges included in content currency dashboard with review status
nodes.description: The system SHALL include all active reference range entries in the content currency dashboard with their last verified date, next review due date, and a status of current, due, or overdue, consistent with the governance model applied to other clinical content components.

nodes.title: Onboarding: resumable state persisted across sessions with admin dashboard progress indicator
nodes.description: The system SHALL persist onboarding state across sessions and allow any administrator for the organisation to resume an incomplete onboarding, with the current progress visible on the admin dashboard.

nodes.title: Deprecation and sunset response headers with integrator notification subscription for deprecated endpoints
nodes.description: The system SHALL include `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers on all deprecated endpoints, and SHALL provide a notification subscription mechanism for integrators to receive deprecation announcements without active API monitoring.

nodes.title: Non-blocking investigation deviation acknowledgement with logged rationale and visible cohort match criteria
nodes.description: The system SHALL require non-blocking acknowledgement with a reason when a clinician deviates from guideline-recommended investigations, log the deviation, and display the cohort match criteria used for the comparator panel.

nodes.title: Plain-language interpretation of coded findings for reviewers
nodes.description: For each reviewer-selected coded finding, the system SHALL generate a plain-English interpretation at the configured reading level with linked source codes and explicit uncertainty when evidence is partial.

nodes.title: Audit quality loops: root cause labelling of drift alerts with 2-year immutable alert history
nodes.description: The system SHALL label each drift alert with a root cause category of model-change-correlated, config-change-correlated, or unexplained, based on whether a model version or pipeline config change was recorded within the comparison window, and SHALL retain alert history immutably for a minimum of 2 years.

nodes.title: Coding correction request structured display schema (original, replacement, concept, rationale)
nodes.description: The system SHALL capture and display a structured coding correction request that includes the original code and display term, the proposed replacement code and display term, the clinical concept both codes are intended to represent, and the requester's rationale; all fields are mandatory.

nodes.title: Structured before/after diff rendering for all change types in the review pane
nodes.description: The system SHALL render a structured side-by-side diff of the before and after change state for all change types, generated from the stored artefact and accessible within the review pane.

nodes.title: Guided population research workspace with plain-English scoping
nodes.description: The research workspace SHALL guide users through mission selection and scoped questions, then run only approved graph analytics templates and return plain-English summaries with query provenance.

nodes.title: Alert fatigue suppression for normal-range investigation results with configurable programme-level thresholds
nodes.description: The system SHALL suppress alert-level notifications for investigation results within the configured normal range for the patient's current pathway stage, with thresholds stored as programme-level configuration.

nodes.title: Source-text highlight linking for reviewer entity selection
nodes.description: The system SHALL render the source clinical text for each extracted entity when a reviewer selects that entity, with the specific character span that generated the entity highlighted; the highlight SHALL correspond exactly to the character offsets stored in the provenance record.

nodes.title: Lossless multi-label span export to model training format
nodes.description: The system SHALL export gold label records containing multi-label spans as one training record per span-label pair, preserving character offsets, entity text, and label independently for each type assignment, so that no label is lost during the transition from annotation to model training.

nodes.title: Mandatory pre-LLM de-identification safety gate enforced in LLM client wrapper with bypass prevention
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory de-identification step as the first transform in every external LLM API call, implemented in the LLM client wrapper so that no caller can bypass it; the step SHALL detect and replace direct patient identifiers before text is transmitted.

nodes.title: Model canary: configurable traffic split with audit trail tagging of canary runs
nodes.description: The system SHALL route a configurable percentage of pipeline runs to a candidate model version while the remainder continue to use the current production model, tagging all canary-assigned runs with the candidate model version and run type in the audit trail.

nodes.title: Reviewer correction event schema immutably linked to extraction provenance
nodes.description: The system SHALL record every reviewer coding correction as an immutable event appended to the extraction provenance record, containing the original code, replacement code, correction rationale, reviewer identity and role, and timestamp.

nodes.title: End-to-end single-patient pipeline processing within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile
nodes.description: The system SHALL complete the full pipeline processing cycle for a single patient — including FHIR record retrieval, NLP entity extraction, guideline evaluation, episode construction, and quality validation — within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile under normal operating conditions.

nodes.title: Multi-tenancy: dedicated Neo4j patient graph per tenant with automated provisioning
nodes.description: The system SHALL assign each tenant a dedicated Neo4j patient graph instance with no shared patient data nodes, and SHALL provide an automated provisioning script that creates the dedicated instance, credentials, and Key Vault secrets as an idempotent operation.

nodes.title: Sandbox tenant with synthetic data and fault injection controls
nodes.description: The platform SHALL provide an isolated sandbox tenant using synthetic patients, parity-equivalent services, and administrator-triggered fault injection for integration testing.

nodes.title: Training corpus stratification report with safety-critical entity count quality gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL generate a corpus stratification report before each training run and SHALL block training with a descriptive error if any designated safety-critical entity type has fewer training examples than the configured minimum threshold.

nodes.title: ConText rule management: full parameter CRUD with test-run gate before activation
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a ConText rule management interface covering trigger phrase, assertion type (present, absent, uncertain, historical, family, hypothetical), scope direction, window size, and pseudo-trigger exceptions, requiring a passed verification test run before activation of any rule set change.

nodes.title: Ontology-constrained clinical relation extraction
nodes.description: Relation linking SHALL emit only edges permitted by SNOMED structural constraints for the selected concepts and SHALL reject invalid combinations with logged reasons.

nodes.title: Audit trail API providing provenance access without clinical record exposure
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a dedicated audit trail API endpoint that returns extraction provenance records, assertion evidence, and correction events for authorised auditors without exposing the underlying clinical record free-text or patient identifiable data.

nodes.title: Programme-level guideline rule set configuration without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL allow programme administrators to define, version, and activate guideline rule sets through configuration management without requiring code changes or a new software deployment; each programme SHALL maintain an independently versioned active rule set.

nodes.title: Per-pathway NICE alignment status report with exportable post-market surveillance output
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a per-pathway NICE alignment status report showing last reviewed date, applicable publications, and open implementation obligations, filterable and exportable for post-market surveillance use.

nodes.title: Integrity-verified deployment package matching approved artifact
nodes.description: Production deployment SHALL only accept packages whose cryptographic hash matches the approved release record, and SHALL reject any package failing verification.

nodes.title: Inference API response schema: one result per span-label pair for multi-type spans
nodes.description: The system SHALL define and enforce an inference API response schema that returns one entity object per span-label pair, enabling downstream consumers to receive multiple typed results for the same character span without requiring additional queries.

nodes.title: Runtime-configurable override error category taxonomy with version tracking
nodes.description: The system SHALL store override error category taxonomies as versioned, runtime-configurable data accessible to engineering team administrators, supporting multi-select at the point of override, with each override record storing the taxonomy version used.

nodes.title: Waiting time target performance panel (FDS 28d, DTT 31d, RTT 62d) with breach highlighting and drill-down
nodes.description: The system SHALL display national waiting time target performance (FDS 28-day, DTT 31-day, RTT 62-day) with breach highlighting and drill-down to episode list within the dashboard, completing within the 3-second load target.

nodes.title: De-identified training corpus with immutable holdout separation
nodes.description: The data platform SHALL enforce separation between training exports and the protected holdout evaluation set such that holdout records cannot be included in training pipelines.

nodes.title: Versioned error reference table with three-category classification and remediation paths for developer-actionable errors
nodes.description: The system SHALL publish a versioned error reference table classifying all error codes into client/server/clinical data categories, with remediation paths for actionable errors, co-versioned with the API specification.

nodes.title: Configurable pathway interval calculation and waiting time target breach detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically calculate pathway interval values for all configured milestone pairs in each episode and SHALL assess each interval against the programme-defined target, flagging breaches with the specific interval, threshold, and overage; all definitions SHALL be stored as runtime-configurable programme data.

nodes.title: Multi-type span classification for overlapping SNOMED concepts
nodes.description: The NER pipeline SHALL emit zero or more SNOMED concept assignments per text span when clinically valid, preserving all non-conflicting semantic types rather than forcing a single winner-take-all label.

nodes.title: Episode classification accuracy gate: minimum 85% F1 against expert consensus
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure episode classification accuracy as F1 against expert consensus on a frozen held-out test set of at least 500 episodes, and SHALL enforce an 85% minimum F1 quality gate that blocks production promotion of any episode classifier model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: PII detection gate: training export aborted and logged if patient identifiers detected
nodes.description: The system SHALL execute a PII detection scan on every training export and SHALL abort the export job with a structured error log entry if any patient identifiers are detected, without writing the output file.

nodes.title: AI-generated labelling on clinician pre-reads with one-click guideline source access and automated pre-session availability
nodes.description: The system SHALL label all AI-generated content in clinician pre-reads with visible AI-generated indicators, provide one-click guideline source access, and populate pre-reads automatically before the clinic preparation window.

nodes.title: UI-only pipeline configuration editing with override gate for failed test mode promotions
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose all pipeline configuration fields as UI form controls and SHALL require a recorded authorised override decision before a configuration that failed test mode can be promoted to active for a live tenant.

nodes.title: Prominent data completeness and reliability indicators on clinician outputs
nodes.description: Every clinician-facing AI-assisted view SHALL display completeness fraction, reliability tier, and last refresh time for the underlying data before any primary action is enabled.

nodes.title: Research workspace results data coverage indicator with low-coverage advisory
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a data coverage indicator on every research workspace result showing population completeness, with a prominent advisory note when coverage falls below 60%.

nodes.title: Terminology currency validation for proposed replacement codes in coding corrections
nodes.description: The system SHALL validate that any proposed replacement code in a coding correction request is present and active in the current release of the relevant controlled terminology (SNOMED CT, ICD-10, or OPCS) at the time of both submission and approval; deprecated codes SHALL be rejected with an explicit error that includes the terminology version consulted.

nodes.title: OAuth2/OIDC-aligned authentication with documented scopes and token lifetimes
nodes.description: The identity service SHALL implement OAuth2 or OIDC-aligned client credentials and authorization code flows with published scope strings, access token TTL, refresh rules, and rotation behaviour.

nodes.title: Per-programme AI processing kill switch activatable without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a per-programme kill switch that, when activated, halts all new AI processing runs for that programme without requiring a code deployment, with activation and clearance immutably audit-logged.

nodes.title: Safety netting: automatic alert suppression on confirmed coded clinical response
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically suppress a safety netting alert when a coded clinical response of an approved type is recorded against the flagged finding, writing the suppression event to the audit trail, and SHALL require a recorded rationale for any manual override of a suppressed alert.

nodes.title: Deterministic episode construction from related encounters
nodes.description: The episode builder SHALL group encounters into episodes using the published grouping rules and SHALL attach pathway milestone states to each episode for review.

nodes.title: Post-treatment recovery markers and comparable trajectories
nodes.description: The system SHALL show guideline-defined expected recovery markers and comparable recovery trajectories for similar patients when reviewing post-treatment follow-up.

nodes.title: Mandatory acknowledgement gate for coverage and data-gap warnings
nodes.description: The system SHALL require explicit clinician acknowledgement before any primary clinical action can proceed when a coverage indicator is below the configured floor or a data-gap warning is active; the acknowledgement SHALL be logged with reviewer identity, timestamp, and the warning state that triggered it.

nodes.title: Rejection return workflow with mandatory reasons-addressed step and parent-child change linkage
nodes.description: The system SHALL require requestors to document a response to each rejection reason before resubmission is permitted, link resubmissions to their parent rejected change, and deliver rejection notifications promptly.

nodes.title: Surface form CRUD interface with match frequency display and duplicate rejection
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a CRUD management interface for surface form entries, with each entry storing text expression, SNOMED concept ID, confidence score, and source, displaying the match frequency from recent pipeline runs, and rejecting duplicate text-concept pairs at save.

nodes.title: Guideline conflict detection before staging with under-review status preserving active availability
nodes.description: The system SHALL detect and flag conflicts between proposed guideline updates and active entries with required resolution before staging, and SHALL support an under-review status that preserves active availability while indicating review in progress to end users.

nodes.title: Safety netting: result-to-reference-range comparison with three-band severity classification
nodes.description: The system SHALL compare each extracted investigation result value against the active reference range for that investigation type and assign a severity band of normal, borderline, or critical, persisting the band classification on the finding node alongside the result value and the reference range version used.

nodes.title: Incorrect SNOMED CT coding from NLP extraction
nodes.description: Source: YAML+FMEA. FMEA refs: FMEA-001. Workshop decision: confirm. Control adequacy: partial. Consolidates FMEA: FMEA-001
nodes.nextAction: Review state and proceed per SOP.

nodes.title: Surface form change gate: staging, review approval, versioning, and rollback
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a staging and review gate for all surface form changes, requiring a recorded approval before activation, and SHALL maintain a full version history of active surface form sets enabling rollback to any prior version with a recorded rollback event.

nodes.title: Encounter classification: managed rules with per-encounter decision persistence and test-pass gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a management interface for encounter classification rules covering keyword triggers, programme assignment, confidence threshold, and fallback behaviour, persisting every classification decision with encounter ID, matched rule, confidence score, and model version, and requiring a test pass before any rule change is activated.

nodes.title: Pipeline configuration dry-run validation before activation
nodes.description: The admin workflow SHALL run the full configured pipeline on approved sample inputs in isolated test mode and SHALL block activation on validation failures or unresolved errors.

nodes.title: Confirmation state reset on reviewer correction with mandatory re-engagement before re-confirmation
nodes.description: The system SHALL reset the AI recommendation confirmation state and require reviewer re-engagement whenever a reviewer edits or removes a confirmed finding, ensuring the updated recommendation is reviewed before final confirmation.

nodes.title: All pipeline and workflow logic defined as graph data and executed by a single generic executor
nodes.description: The system SHALL define all pipeline and workflow logic as graph data stored as WorkflowDefinition and WorkflowStep nodes in the primary database, and SHALL execute all workflows through a single generic executor that reads step definitions at runtime, so that new workflows and pipeline configurations can be added by inserting graph data without any code changes or deployments.

nodes.title: FHIR R4 compliant API for all patient record ingestion and audit result export
nodes.description: The system SHALL retrieve all patient clinical records exclusively via a FHIR R4 compliant API, and SHALL export audit results and pipeline outputs as FHIR resources, so that all patient data exchange uses a standards-based interface that does not depend on proprietary source system integrations.

nodes.title: Large-scale coding correction mandatory secondary review threshold gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory secondary reviewer approval for any coding correction that affects a number of historical patient records at or above a configurable programme-level threshold, and SHALL block the approval of such corrections unless two distinct credentialed reviewers have each recorded a decision.

nodes.title: Onboarding checklist: six mandatory steps with completion recording and programme activation gate
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide a six-step onboarding checklist covering org creation, tenant provisioning, FHIR endpoint registration, programme selection, user role assignment, and first pipeline test run, recording completion timestamp and user identity on each step, and blocking programme activation until all steps are confirmed.

nodes.title: Risk-scored change queue with production deployment interlock
nodes.description: Pending changes SHALL appear in a single queue ordered by configurable risk score and SHALL be blocked from any production pipeline until approved.

nodes.title: Human-review gate blocking downstream actions from unreviewed guideline alerts
nodes.description: The system SHALL block any downstream product action that is triggered by a guideline alert unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision against that specific alert; the enforcement SHALL occur at the API layer and SHALL be logged in the immutable audit trail.

nodes.title: Deployment status panel on approved change records visible from review interface
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface deployment status (pending/deployed/rejected) with timestamp and deploying user on each approved change record within the review interface, updated in real time.

nodes.title: Programme inclusion criteria stored as versioned configuration applied without code deployment
nodes.description: The system SHALL store patient inclusion criteria for each audit programme as versioned configuration data, applied consistently at each pipeline run without requiring code changes, with full version history retained.

nodes.title: FHIR R4: coded findings as Observation, milestones as EpisodeOfCare, audit results as MeasureReport with meta.source provenance
nodes.description: The system SHALL expose coded clinical findings as UK Core-conformant FHIR Observation resources, pathway milestones as FHIR EpisodeOfCare resources, and clinical audit results as FHIR MeasureReport resources linked to Measure definitions, with every resource including a meta.source element identifying the generating LEO Core AI version and tenant.

nodes.title: All secrets retrieved exclusively from Azure Key Vault with CI secret scanning and startup failure on missing secrets
nodes.description: The system SHALL retrieve all secrets exclusively from Azure Key Vault using DefaultAzureCredential; no secrets SHALL appear in source code, committed environment files, or container images; services SHALL exit on secret retrieval failure.

nodes.title: Runtime relation linking method disclosure (model prediction vs LLM fallback) to reviewer
nodes.description: The system SHALL record and surface to the reviewer whether each relation link was produced by the NER model prediction or by the LLM fallback mechanism, including the confidence score for model-produced links, so that reviewers can apply appropriate scepticism to low-confidence and fallback relations.

nodes.title: Audit agent resource bounds: configurable iteration limit and token/cost budget enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL enforce configurable per-record tool-use iteration limits and per-run token and cost budgets on the training label audit agent, halting and alerting when any limit is breached.

nodes.title: Independent source conformance and safety checks for guideline updates
nodes.description: The change review workflow SHALL require separate recorded outcomes for source-text conformance and implementation safety before a guideline update can be promoted to active content.

nodes.title: Shortlisting recall quality gate: minimum 95% recall on gold-standard labelled dataset
nodes.description: The system SHALL measure shortlisting recall against a gold-standard labelled dataset at each model release and SHALL enforce a minimum recall quality gate of 0.95 that blocks production promotion of any shortlisting model that fails this threshold.

nodes.title: Quality regression alert escalation with automatic pipeline pause on unacknowledged threshold breach
nodes.description: The system SHALL implement a multi-stage alert escalation sequence for coding quality regressions that routes unacknowledged alerts to escalating recipients and eventually sets a pipeline pause flag that prevents new processing batches until an administrator clears it.

nodes.title: LEO Core AI component version identifier included in every API response for downstream traceability
nodes.description: The system SHALL include a LEO Core AI component version identifier in every API response, enabling downstream integrators to link API outputs to a specific software version in their technical files.

nodes.title: Safety netting: worklist filter by severity, days outstanding, and patient cohort
nodes.description: The system SHALL provide worklist filter controls allowing a clinician to filter safety netting entries by severity band, days outstanding bucket, and patient cohort, with filter state preserved for the duration of the session.

nodes.title: Cohort metadata disclosure in clinician-facing outputs
nodes.description: The system SHALL include cohort size, record date range, and cohort refresh date in every clinician-facing output that is derived from a matched patient cohort; these metadata fields SHALL be displayed adjacently to the output they describe.

nodes.title: Automated training-label audit with bounded auto-fix and review queues
nodes.description: The system SHALL scan training labels for defined defect classes, apply only auto-fix rules marked safe, and route all other defects to the human review queue with reasons.

nodes.title: AI model configurations stored as graph nodes with runtime resolution and no hardcoded model names
nodes.description: The system SHALL store all AI model configurations as AIModel nodes in the graph database and SHALL resolve model parameters at runtime from these nodes; no model names or provider parameters SHALL be hardcoded in application code.

nodes.title: Cohort versioning: each edit creates a new version recorded on all dependent runs
nodes.description: The system SHALL version cohort definitions such that each modification creates a new version without altering prior versions, and SHALL record the specific cohort version used on each analytics or research mission run for reproducibility.

nodes.title: Model canary: automatic halt and production rollback on per-entity F1 regression
nodes.description: The system SHALL automatically halt a canary and reinstate the production model when F1 for any entity type drops below a configurable per-entity threshold, writing the rollback event to the audit trail with the entity type, F1 delta, and timestamp.

nodes.title: SBAR: source encounter and coded entity provenance links on every clinical statement
nodes.description: The system SHALL link each clinical statement in a generated SBAR section to the source encounter node and coded entity from which it was derived, surfacing these provenance links in the SBAR user interface and preserving them in the exported record.

nodes.title: Post-processing preservation of overlapping same-label spans with divergent terminology lookups
nodes.description: The system SHALL preserve overlapping spans that share the same SNOMED semantic type label when their normalised terminology lookup terms differ, treating them as distinct clinical entities rather than duplicates requiring deduplication.

nodes.title: Change history pattern surfacing and systematic guideline divergence flagging in impact review panel
nodes.description: The system SHALL surface previous changes of the same type with outcomes and incidents, and SHALL flag systematic guideline divergence when a change modifies a guideline-mapped rule, with the flag generated independently of the requestor.

nodes.title: Coding quality metrics trend dashboard with 30-cycle history and threshold reference lines
nodes.description: The system SHALL display a quality metrics trend dashboard showing time-series charts of coding quality metrics across monitoring cycles, with configurable threshold reference lines and data point drill-down.

nodes.title: Benchmark comparison charts in audit exports
nodes.description: The audit report generator SHALL include interpretable charts comparing local metrics to national benchmarks with axis labels, units, cohort definitions, and data freshness dates.

nodes.title: Unified Intelligence Console with stage health and next action
nodes.description: The admin UI SHALL present all model-improvement stages in one console with health indicators and a single recommended next action per failing stage.

nodes.title: Disorder gate fail-closed with GATE_FAILED verdict
nodes.description: The disorder verifier SHALL record a DisorderVerdict.GATE_FAILED result on any provider failure, parse failure, or consensus disagreement that cannot be resolved. When GATE_FAILED is raised the entity SHALL be marked __needs_review__ and __gate_failed__ and SHALL NOT be eligible for autonomous coding in any mode (HITL, autonomous, or unknown). The verdict SHALL also be recorded on the entity as disorder_verdict for downstream audit.

nodes.title: Configurable margin-derived pricing with per-tenant discounts, 100% discount cap, and immutable pricing change log
nodes.description: The system SHALL derive list prices from a configurable margin target, support per-tenant time-limited and perpetual discounts applied without code deployment, cap total discounts at 100%, and immutably log all pricing changes.

nodes.title: Reviewer engagement metrics logging and clinical safety officer monitoring view for automation bias detection
nodes.description: The system SHALL log reviewer engagement metrics (time on evidence, findings reviewed, assertion changes, corrections) per review session, and SHALL provide a clinical safety officer monitoring view with low-engagement flags and configurable thresholds.

nodes.title: Credential scope and conflict checks before approval actions
nodes.description: The system SHALL deny approval actions unless the authenticated principal holds an active credential covering the clinical scope of the change and has no recorded conflict of interest for that item.

nodes.title: The Test Patients page shall live in the Knowledge area of the admin app, with a filter for which part of the AI to test
nodes.description: The system SHALL show the test patient library as a tab called Test Patients inside /admin/knowledge, next to the existing tabs (Training Data, Surface Forms, Context Rules, AI Instructions, Clinical Guidelines, Pathways, Domains, Terminology, AI Summarisation). The page SHALL show four count tiles at the top, one for each part of the AI, showing how many test patients are saved, passing and regressing. A filter at the top of the table SHALL let the reviewer choose All or one of the four parts of the AI. There SHALL be one main button called Build patient whose form changes depending on which part of the AI is selected. Each row SHALL have an Edit button and a Replay button. The old page at /admin/guidance/test-patients SHALL be removed and every link to it inside the codebase SHALL be updated.

nodes.title: Guideline deprecation dependency closure enforcement
nodes.description: The system SHALL enumerate all dependent artefacts for a guideline and SHALL prevent deprecation until each dependency is migrated or explicitly waived with recorded rationale.

nodes.title: Label verification step multi-label annotation fidelity
nodes.description: The system SHALL ensure that the label verification step reads, displays, and writes back all SNOMED type labels for every span-label pair in a multi-label annotation without collapsing or dropping any label; any reduction in the label count between input and output is treated as a pipeline failure.

nodes.title: Episode classification status schema (confirmed, excluded, inconclusive)
nodes.description: The system SHALL assign each constructed episode a classification status of confirmed, excluded, or inconclusive based on the programme-defined classification rules, and SHALL display this status with a plain-language explanation to the reviewer.

nodes.title: Provenance record immutable retention policy enforcement (7-year minimum)
nodes.description: The system SHALL retain all extraction provenance records in an immutable, append-only store for a minimum of 7 years from the date of creation, and SHALL enforce a write-once policy that rejects any update or delete operation on a provenance record within the retention window.

nodes.title: Patient data encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 minimum
nodes.description: The system SHALL encrypt all patient clinical data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent, and SHALL transmit all patient data over TLS 1.2 or higher, with all encryption keys managed exclusively via Azure Key Vault, so that patient data is protected against interception and unauthorised access at the storage and transport layers.

nodes.title: Episode builder fallback referral-claim and evidence-wins merge
nodes.description: Two correlated updates to the episode-builder package:  1. Two-pass referral matching: strict same-site Pass 1 followed    by site-agnostic Pass 2 for diagnoses that remain floating.    ep.referral_match_method tags every episode with    'strict_site' | 'fallback_any_site' | 'none'. When Pass 2    still leaves a diagnosis floating, ep.referral_date is    NULL (never back-filled from the diagnosis date) and    ep.referral_inferred is false.  2. Evidence-wins duplicate merging: per-patient referral-date    clustering (including NSS episodes), text corroboration of    cancer_type against the diagnosis_confirmed encounter text,    and a new MOVE_LINKS_Q Cypher query that migrates every    IS_PART_OF edge from duplicates to the primary, preserving    milestone_type.  Together these changes bring the canonical confirmed-cancer count in line with the true patient cohort and raise the 2WW-route subset to reflect UK primary-care reality.

nodes.title: Two-pass referral matching with strict-then-fallback claim and honest NULL
nodes.description: The episode builder SHALL match each cancer diagnosis anchor to a preceding referral anchor using a two-pass strategy. Pass 1 keeps current strict same-site behaviour: only a referral whose site key equals the diagnosis site or is non_site_specific may be claimed. Any diagnosis still unmatched after Pass 1 runs through Pass 2, which claims the nearest unclaimed referral within DIAG_LOOKBACK_DAYS regardless of site key, subject to MIN_REFERRAL_TO_DIAG_DAYS. Episodes produced via Pass 2 SHALL be tagged ep.referral_match_method = fallback_any_site so downstream audit surfaces can distinguish strict from fallback claims. When NO referral can be claimed, ep.referral_date SHALL NOT be synthesised from the diagnosis encounter date; it SHALL be persisted as NULL, and ep.referral_inferred SHALL be false.

nodes.title: Label-verification and training-export lossless writer
nodes.description:
Retrospective DO documenting `services/api/app/services/label_verifier.py::_process_label` and `libs/ner/training_label_writer.py` which together process and export one record per span-label pair through the label-verification queue to the training JSONL export.

Gap (tracked in improvements-backlog batch-04 / DI-EE80C271 + DI-6EFD68D0): no count-in == count-out invariant is currently enforced so silent collapse of multi-label span pairs would not be detected by existing tests.

nodes.title: deidentify_with_span Helper and DOCUMENTS Evidence Sentence Storage
nodes.description: Adds deidentify_with_span() to libs/utils/deidentify.py: de-identifies the sentence then re-locates the span by case-insensitive search, returning (-1, -1) sentinel when the span is not found. Updates write_documents_from_sentences_payload to call this function and store evidence_sentence, evidence_start, evidence_end, sentence_index, holdout on every DOCUMENTS relationship.

nodes.title: Consensus runner v2 (libs/llm_client/consensus.py)
nodes.description: Rewritten consensus runner with two honest execution modes. Default single-model path issues one AWS Bedrock call with a strict-reminder parse-retry. Opt-in dual-model path (CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) runs AWS small + Azure small in parallel with AWS big arbitration on disagreement or single-provider failure. Fail-closed when all providers fail. Docstring updated to reflect actual behaviour. Consumed by disorder verifier and coding-verifier call sites without caller-side changes.

nodes.title: Research workspace and cohort builder surface
nodes.description: Umbrella DO for UN-47B82B96 research workspace. Components: services/analytics_api/app/services cohort builder (DI-DD67ACFF, DI-93162C3C), services/ui research workspace view (DI-9DCBC4BA), de-identification export pipeline (DI-58988BF2). Code-gap: full cohort builder UI planned but incomplete.

nodes.title: SBAR generation subgraph
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/sbar.py` and associated state in `libs/pipeline_graph/state.py` that generates SBAR summaries from coded encounters and pathway state. Provenance writer in `libs/cypher/documents_queries.py` supplies link-back capability.

Gaps (batch-13 theme A): DI-8804DA01 finalisation gate with AI-original/edit delta is not implemented; DI-740BE510 per-statement provenance regression test missing.

nodes.title: Relation linking subgraph with method-tagged model+LLM merge
nodes.description:
Design output documenting `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/relation_linking.py` covering ontology-constrained relation extraction (DI-3EA60D5A), typed-tuple persistence with confidence (DI-318B864C), and method disclosure (DI-2D9F5064). Implements a model-first relation predictor, optional LLM fallback, and a merge step that now tags each relation with extraction_method in {model, llm, model+llm}. Runtime policy enforcement via libs/relations/policy.py.

Code improvement delivered 2026-04-17 in the same changeset: _merge_model_and_llm now preserves and propagates extraction_method; _apply_relation_linking writes extraction_method into the persisted relation dict.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-05): schema_mapper VALID_RELATION_TYPES is a superset of policy allowlist; no E2E integrity parity check; no blocking F1 gate in canary promotion.

nodes.title: Pathway intervals, waiting times, benchmark + IMD analytics
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the analytics surface for pathway intervals, national benchmarks and IMD deprivation: `services/analytics_api/app/routers/imd.py`, `_audit_helpers.py`, `dashboards.py`, `services/fhir_api/app/services/benchmark_loader.py`, `scripts/build_ncda_*.py`, `libs/cypher/admin_queries.py`, ODS sync in `services/ods_sync/`.

Gaps (batch-14 theme B): DI-EE4E6477 HITL gate on pathway intervals; national benchmark UI overlays for all dashboards (DI-BA2C8F3E).

nodes.title: DensityProvider and density-aware primitive resolution
nodes.description: - DensityContext exports a React context with value   'compact' | 'comfortable' | 'spacious' and a setter. - DensityProvider decides the initial value using route-match   (patient-reachable prefixes) + localStorage + default. - useDensity() returns the current value; useDensityTokens()   returns the padding/min-height/font-size map for the   active tier from theme/tokens.ts DENSITY_MAP. - Settings page exposes a Density toggle; writes to   localStorage 'leo-density' and updates context. - Patient-reachable routes (/portal, /mail, /safety-netting,   /games, /care/wellbeing, /sign-in) force 'spacious'.

nodes.title: LEO UI density modes (Compact, Comfortable, Spacious) with patient-route safe defaults
nodes.description: The LEO UI SHALL expose three density modes - Compact, Comfortable (default for staff), and Spacious (default for patient-reachable routes) - controlled by a DensityProvider React context whose value is driven by a user preference persisted to the browser (localStorage key leo-density) and read at app-root. Every primitive component (Button, Chip, Input, Table row, ListItem, Card) MUST resolve its padding, min-height, and font-size from the active density tier. Patient-reachable routes under /portal, /mail, /safety-netting, /games, /care/wellbeing, and /sign-in MUST default to Spacious. Spacious MUST guarantee >=44x44 CSS pixel touch targets.

nodes.title: Admin Guidance UI -- Plain Language Guideline Management
nodes.description: Four-file Next.js/MUI implementation: orchestrator page.tsx with one h1; NiceLoaderSection with Autocomplete catalogue search + SSE ingest progress; RuleReviewSection with plain-English HITL review cards and ConfirmDialog for bulk approve; BitmapLifecycleSection with version accordion and ConfirmDialog for activate. AppShell.tsx updated with Guidance nav item. All copy targets reading age 11. All fetch errors surface via Alert.

nodes.title: Reviewer workflow and change-control surface

UNs: UN-F6A0C5BA, UN-ED00ED74, UN-8659DD53, UN-EA93F7B7, UN-785DFCDE. Components: services/api/app/routers approvals + change-queue, services/ui review surface, deployment interlock in CI.

nodes.title: Knowledge base authoring and staging surface

UNs: UN-407F090F, UN-4BD56518, UN-B9FDC3CA, UN-E8A5B04A, UN-06388412. Components in services/terminology_api + services/knowledge_api + services/ui knowledge authoring views. Code-gap: some staging gates are manual pending full change-control UI.

nodes.title: Guideline conformance evaluator and rule extraction
nodes.description:
Design output documenting the guideline evaluator and rule-extraction surface: `services/terminology_api/app/services/guideline_evaluator.py`, `services/terminology_api/app/routers/guidelines.py`, `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/guidance_rule_extraction_v2_impl.py`, tests in `services/terminology_api/tests/test_guideline_evaluator.py`.

nodes.title: fix_polarity_encoded_findings guard in post_processing.py and terminology.py
nodes.description: Adds fix_polarity_encoded_findings() to libs/pipeline/post_processing.py. The function iterates over resolved entities and, for any entity whose semantic_tag is "finding" or "observable entity" and whose SNOMED preferred term matches _POLARITY_SUFFIX_RE (ends with "absent", "not detected", "not found", "not present", or "negative" before the semantic tag parenthesis), forces assertion="present" and sets _assertion_guard="polarity_encoded_finding".  Called from two locations:   1. post_processing.py layer 7d (_run_double_neg_guards), after      fix_double_negated_situations, for the training path.   2. terminology.py _resolve_terms, after fix_double_negated_situations,      for the runtime coding pipeline.  This closes the gap where the existing double-negation guard handles only situation concepts with prefix-negated PTs. Finding concepts encode polarity as a suffix word; this guard handles that pattern.

nodes.title: Container Infrastructure
nodes.description: Azure Container Apps infrastructure defined as Bicep templates with supporting Dockerfiles for each service. The Bicep modules provision the container environment, Key Vault for secrets, and configure auto-scaling rules. Dockerfiles produce minimal, reproducible images for each ACA service; coding and analysis logic ships inside the pipeline-worker image via shared Python packages (no separate worker images).

nodes.title: Token source of truth for LEO UI: theme.ts, theme/tokens.ts, theme/tokens.css
nodes.description: - theme/tokens.ts exports TYPE_SCALE, SPACING, RADIUS, MOTION,   FOCUS_RING, and CONTRAST_PAIRS objects. Each pair is a   {fg, bg, role} triplet with >=4.5:1 computed contrast. - theme.ts consumes tokens.ts, adds h1..h6 typography   overrides with minimum 16px body, and enables focus-visible   outlines that meet size and contrast. - theme/tokens.css emits each token as a CSS custom property   under :root and inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion:   reduce) to zero non-essential animation duration and   inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) to swap colour   pairs. It is imported once in layout.tsx. - layout.tsx sets html.lang and html.dir; globals.css keeps   print rules, removes the hardcoded 14px from .skip-link,   adds prefers-reduced-motion overrides.

nodes.title: LEO UI design tokens and accessible theme foundation
nodes.description: The LEO UI SHALL expose a single, typed, tokenised design system (colour pairs, type scale, spacing scale, radius scale, motion scale, focus ring) that every surface consumes through MUI theme and matching CSS custom properties. Tokens MUST guarantee a minimum 16px base body font size, a minimum 12px chip/caption size, >=4.5:1 text contrast, >=3:1 non-text contrast, a >=3px visible focus ring with >=3:1 contrast, and MUST support prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme at the CSS custom-property level so any component can adapt without duplicating logic.

nodes.title: Post-SNOMED double-negation assertion correction
nodes.description: Adds fix_double_negated_situations() to the post-processing stack. The function inspects each entity after SNOMED preferred term (PT) is available and corrects assertion=absent on situation concepts whose PT begins with a negative prefix (No, Absence of, Not, Unable to, Never).  Two wiring points ensure both pipeline paths are covered: - Layer 7d in run_post_processing_with_trace (training path, where   entities already carry PT from the training data store). - End of _resolve_terms in terminology.py (runtime path, where PT   is first populated by terminology resolution).

nodes.title: Appointment Header Filter and Resolver Input Normalisation
nodes.description: Two complementary precision improvements to the clinical coding pipeline:  1. Appointment/admin header filter (DI-LEO-AI-080):    is_header_sentence(text) detects administrative header lines using    a conservative regex and filter_header_sentences(chunks) removes    them from the sentence list before any extractor is called.  2. Resolver input normalisation (DI-LEO-AI-004 bug fix):    _normalise_for_resolve(text) strips trailing numeric lab values    plus SI units (e.g. "1.05 mmol/L") and EMIS local code suffixes    (e.g. "(X78gA)") from evidence phrases before they are sent to    /terminology/resolve, preventing the resolver from returning unit    qualifier concepts instead of the intended lab test concepts.

nodes.title: De-identification library + deid validator guard
nodes.description:

Provides regex-based NHS-identifier, postcode, DOB and name redaction with an injectable organisation pattern, and a validator that prevents PHI leaking into downstream LLM prompts.

Gaps (batch-15 Theme A): protected evaluation holdout corpus enforcement (UN-70A35225) and measured recall against a labelled PHI corpus (UN-C2F187E9 acceptance criterion ~99.9% PII recall) are not verified in CI. Backlogged.

nodes.title: Stage-at-diagnosis enrichment modules and audit surfacing

nodes.title: LLM Interpretation Module

A prompt registry manages versioned system prompts, and a factory abstracts the underlying LLM provider so the system can switch between Azure OpenAI models without code changes.

The audit page section components gain "View cases" buttons that navigate to /care/patients with URL params encoding the current date/org/cancer-type filter context.

nodes.title: Card-based Operations UX

nodes.title: Dashboard and Safety Netting UI

The dashboard gives clinicians and practice managers an at-a-glance view of coding quality and QOF performance. The safety netting worklist highlights patients whose care episodes may have missing or incorrect clinical codes, allowing clinicians to review and action them.

nodes.title: Clinical Guidelines workflow rebuilt on the design-system
nodes.description: Single Next.js page under services/ui/src/app/admin/guidance/page.tsx that orchestrates the four child sections (NiceLoaderSection, LoadedGuidelinesPanel, RuleReviewSection, BitmapLifecycleSection). Wave E Phase 5 swaps the legacy heavy chrome for a sticky design-system jump strip and motion-enabled StepCard sections:    - SegmentedTabs jump strip (sticky, blur-backed) at the top     with three tabs (load / review / compile). Selecting a     tab smoothly scrolls the matching StepCard into view.   - StepCard: fm.section with 12px radius, 1px divider border,     3px tone-coded left accent strip, framer-motion stagger     entry. Each StepCard owns the numbered pip + title +     description in its header, then renders the existing     child section in its body. nodes.title: Clinical Guidelines orchestrator chrome on @leo/design-system primitives

nodes.title: Pipeline Orchestration Service
nodes.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end clinical coding and analysis pipeline. Manages job lifecycle from submission through coding, analysis, and completion. Dispatches work to coding and analysis workers via the message bus, tracks job progress, and handles retries and failures.

nodes.title: LangGraph pipeline executor with PlanDefinition-driven subgraph dispatch
nodes.description: The system SHALL execute pipelines defined as directed workflow graphs using a LangGraph-based pipeline with FHIR PlanDefinition-driven subgraph dispatch, dispatching each step to the appropriate worker service via message bus, supporting branching, conditional edges, fan-out/fan-in patterns, and cross-pipeline triggers

nodes.title: Unified pipeline-jobs queue with PipelineJobMessage dispatch and progress events
nodes.description: The system SHALL consume pipeline job messages from a single pipeline-jobs queue using unified PipelineJobMessage format (Azure Service Bus / Redis Streams), dispatch them to the appropriate worker service, track job state, and publish progress events

nodes.title: Per-episode specialist visit claiming algorithm
nodes.description: Replaces the global-per-site-key _group_specialists function with a per-episode claiming algorithm implemented as _claim_specialists_for_episodes.  Algorithm: 1. Sort all specialist visit anchors ascending by encounter_date. 2. Build _EpisodeSpec for each episode (ep_id, site_key, ref_date, window_end).    - Closed episodes: window_end = diagnosis date (latest encounter in group).    - Open episodes: window_end = ref_date + 365 days. 3. Process episodes in ref_date ascending order. 4. For each episode, find the earliest unclaimed specialist visit where:    - site key is compatible (_site_keys_compatible)    - encounter_date >= ref_date    - encounter_date <= window_end 5. Claim the visit (mark index as used); store _SpecialistClaim on episode. 6. Episodes with no matching visit receive _SpecialistClaim(specialist_seen=False).  _write_episode now accepts a _SpecialistClaim directly instead of dicts, eliminating the dict.get(site_key) lookup that previously allowed one dict entry to supply data to multiple episodes.

nodes.title: Per-episode temporal claiming of specialist visit anchors
nodes.description: The episode detection system SHALL attribute each specialist visit anchor to at most one EpisodeOfCare node using a per-episode temporal claiming algorithm. A specialist visit is eligible for an episode only if (a) its encounter date is on or after the episode referral date, (b) its encounter date is on or before the episode window end date (diagnosis date for closed episodes; referral_date + 365 days for open episodes), and (c) its cancer site key is compatible with the episode site key. Episodes are processed in referral-date order (earliest first) so that earlier pathways have priority over later pathways when multiple episodes share a site key. Each visit that is successfully claimed is removed from the pool and cannot be attributed to any other episode.

nodes.title: next/font DM Sans + subtitle1/2 un-monospaced

nodes.title: Post-specialist outcome inference engine for stale episodes

nodes.title: Unified Encounter Coding Agent
nodes.description: A LangGraph StateGraph implementing a clinical coding/audit agent with SNOMED terminology tools. Three nodes:   load_encounter  -- formats state, sets mode/tier/token budget   coder           -- cyclic LLM + tool dispatch loop   post_process    -- validates verdict, adds metadata, extracts NER offsets  Seven Bedrock toolSpec tools are provided: search_snomed, lookup_concept, resolve_evidence, get_patient_demographics, get_patient_problems, read_context, submit_verdict (terminal). The graph loops between coder and the tool dispatch inside coder until submit_verdict is called, max iterations is hit, or the token budget is exhausted. The post_process node adds the metadata block and validates character offsets.  In audit mode the verdict matches the legacy format (missing, overcoded, wrong_assertion) for backward compatibility with the audit pipeline. In code mode the verdict contains an entities list with action=add for all extracted concepts. Both modes include sentence+offset for NER data.

nodes.title: Assertion-free LLM extraction output with post-processing as sole assertion authority
nodes.description: The LLM extractor output schema no longer includes an assertion field. Both extraction code paths (_extractor.py build path and llm_extractor.py LLMExtractor) always initialise assertion to "present" after parsing LLM JSON, discarding any assertion value the LLM may have included. The extraction_v1.py system prompt and the _OUTPUT_FORMAT fallback schema do not instruct the LLM to output assertion.  All non-present assertions are assigned downstream by the shared post-processing pipeline (libs/pipeline/post_processing.py):   - Layer 3: scope guard (reclassifies present -> hypothetical/possible)   - Layer 7: ConText MedSpaCy detection (absent, historical, family,     planned, possible, declined, cancelled, hypothetical)   - Layer 7b: referral procedure guard (reverts possible -> present)   - Layer 7d: double-negation situation guard (reverts absent -> present)   - Layer 9: disorder gate (sets historical/refuted/possible for disorders)  This eliminates the one-way error trap where an LLM-assigned non-present assertion could not be corrected by ConText.

nodes.title: Coding review modal split and plain-language redesign

The dialog adds a PageIntro at the top explaining why this queue exists, how to work it, and what each action does. Clinical terms (assertion, semantic tag, suppress, declined, absent, hypothetical, planned) render through GlossaryTerm or HelpPopover with FK grade <=9 copy.

nodes.title: Benign Cancer Pathway Closure Detection
nodes.description: The episode builder detects 'No evidence of cancer found' (SNOMED 395100000) encounters scoped to each individual episode window and closes episodes as 'closed_benign' when the concept is coded within 365 days of the referral date. A confirmed cancer diagnosis always takes precedence.  The detection is implemented as _benign_closure_for_episode() in episode_builder.py, which queries Neo4j with explicit after_date and before_date parameters derived from the referral date + 365 days. The no_cancer_discharge FHIR ValueSet is seeded into Neo4j by _seed_no_cancer_discharge_valueset.py and linked to the cancer_audit AuditDomain. Surface form aliases for benign discharge phrases and 2WW clinic shorthand are pinned via _pin_2ww_clinic_aliases.py.

nodes.title: Staging enrichment uses post-diagnosis window with site-specialty filter
nodes.description: The staging enrichment subgraph SHALL derive stage only from encounter text inside a fixed post-diagnosis window of STAGING_WINDOW_DAYS days (default 90) starting at the episode's diagnosis_date. Within that window, evidence rows SHALL be filtered through the cancer-site specialty marker for the episode's cancer_type so that TNM, Gleason and explicit stage text belonging to a different concurrent cancer pathway cannot contribute to this episode's stage. If no evidence rows match the specialty marker, the filter SHALL fall back to the unfiltered rows to avoid producing a null stage where the window contained relevant evidence that simply did not mention the site keyword.

nodes.title: Broadened breast specialty marker
nodes.description: Extend SPECIALTY_MARKERS['breast'] in libs/clinical_scoping/specialty_markers.py to cover common UK primary-care surface forms missed by the current regex. Updated parsers in services/coding_worker/app/pipeline/llm_extractor.py and libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/_extractor.py to parse, normalise, and clamp assertion and confidence, resolve absolute spans via SpanResolver, and propagate the new fields onto ExtractedTerm and ExtractionItem records. nodes.title: Audit-Driven Automated Encounter Remediation

nodes.title: Canonical relation schema, policy validation, relation train/eval, and model-first runtime linking

Runtime relation linking:    - relation_linking subgraph predicts relations model-first and calls LLM      fallback only for low-confidence coverage.    - persisted relation rows are canonicalized and deduplicated.

nodes.title: LLM extractor paths updated for span resolution, self-rated assertion, self-rated confidence, and clinical-qualifier preservation
nodes.description: Both LLM extractor implementations (the coding_worker extractor and the WorkflowEngine subgraph extractor) are updated to:  - Call the shared SpanResolver (DO-LEO-AI-110) so every extracted   term carries accurate absolute character offsets into the   encounter text. - Parse the LLM's emitted ``assertion`` value into the   ExtractionItem / ExtractedTerm assertion field, clamping to the   controlled vocabulary and defaulting to ``present`` when missing. - Parse the LLM's self-rated ``confidence`` in [0, 1], clamping to   valid range and defaulting to 1.0 when missing. - Receive updated system prompt instructions that tell the LLM to   preserve clinical qualifiers (onset, chronicity, certainty,   laterality) in the ``lookup_term`` field, and to emit assertion   and confidence as required fields.

nodes.title: _rescue_diagnosis_for_open_episode helper + _build_open_episode wiring
nodes.description: Adds a pure helper function to ``_builder.py`` -- ``_rescue_diagnosis_for_open_episode(diagnosis_anchors, site_key, ref_date)`` -- that returns ``(earliest_diag_date, anchors_on_that_date)`` when at least one site-compatible confirmed diagnosis anchor falls in ``[ref_date, ref_date + STALE_HARD_DAYS]``, and ``None`` otherwise. The helper applies the existing ``_extract_condition_key_from_anchor`` and ``_site_keys_compatible`` helpers so a specific-site diagnosis must match the referral site while ``unknown`` / ``non_site_specific`` diagnoses are eligible for any site.  ``_build_open_episode`` is updated to call this helper AFTER specialist-letter inference and benign-closure detection have run and AFTER ``_first_seen_link_anchors`` has been moved before ``_write_episode`` (defect fix from DI-LEO-AI-145). When the computed status is ``in_progress`` and the helper returns a rescue, the builder sets ``status = 'completed'``, ``end_date = rescue_date.isoformat()``, ``hitl_flag = True``, and ``hitl_reason = 'Auto-completed: confirmed cancer diagnosis text in episode window. Verify cancer site and pathway outcome.'``. The diagnosis anchors at the earliest rescue date are passed to ``_link_encounters_to_episode`` with milestone_type ``'diagnosis_confirmed'`` so the IS_PART_OF edge is written in the same builder pass.

nodes.title: Extended value-unit linker in post-processing Layer 6
nodes.description: Extends link_observable_value_units in libs/pipeline/post_processing.py with two additional linking passes beyond the existing numeric entity pass:  Pass 2 - String result linking:   Builds a list of entity indices whose text is in _RESULT_DESCRIPTOR_TEXTS.   For each observable_entity that still has no value, finds the nearest   string result entity within 40 characters and sets obs["value"] to the   lowercased text and obs["unit"] to "".  Pass 3 - Raw-text fallback scan:   When encounter_text is provided, scans a window of up to 60 characters   immediately before each still-unlinked observable entity's start offset.   Applies _VALUE_UNIT_RE for numeric matches and _RESULT_DESCRIPTOR_TEXTS   for string matches. Attaches the last (closest) match found.  The function signature gains an optional encounter_text: str = "" parameter. The call site in run_post_processing threads the existing encounter_text argument through.  A new private predicate _is_string_result_text is added alongside _is_numeric_measurement_text for use in Pass 2.

nodes.title: Layer 6 value-unit linker extension for string descriptors and raw-text fallback
nodes.description: The post-processing Layer 6 value-unit linker SHALL be extended to: (1) attach string-based result descriptors (positive, negative, borderline, reactive, non-reactive, and all other terms in _RESULT_DESCRIPTOR_TEXTS) as obs[value] on the nearest observable_entity within 40 characters; (2) perform a raw-text window scan of up to 60 characters preceding an observable entity's start offset to capture numeric or string values that were not extracted as separate entity spans by the NER model; and (3) accept an optional encounter_text parameter so that both the entity-list path and the raw-text fallback path operate in a single function call without breaking existing callers.

nodes.title: Agentic Training Label Auditor with Terminology Tool-Use
nodes.description: A two-pass automated audit system for TrainingLabel records (verification subgraph, not standalone auditor):  Pass 1 - Standard Audit (no tools): - Opus reviews every entity for span, assertion, label, and value errors - Safe auto-fixes applied immediately (assertion, label, text, value, unit) - SNOMED issues flagged as needs_review proposals - AutoFixCapMonitor tracks sliding-window fix rate  Pass 2 - Agentic Terminology Verification (tools): - Filters pass-1 results for SNOMED needs_review entities - Invokes Opus with Bedrock toolConfig for four tools:     resolve_term, get_related_concepts, get_descendants, get_second_opinion - ToolExecutor delegates terminology calls to Haiku via Terminology API - SecondOpinionProvider: blind Haiku call with only original data,     no Opus verdict or reasoning - prevents anchoring bias - Results inform Opus verdict; hard cap of 5 iterations per entity - CostGuardrail halts if token/dollar budget exceeded  API surface: POST/GET/POST /training/labels/opus-audit endpoints expose the auditor to the Operations UI (TrainingDataPanel step 3).  All tool calls (including second opinions) recorded in JSONL audit trail. SNOMED fields remain READONLY -- tool results produce proposals only.

nodes.description: The system SHALL verify safety-critical clinical decisions using dual-model consensus: two independent LLM providers (AWS Haiku, Azure GPT-5 mini) run in parallel and a larger model (AWS Sonnet) arbitrates when they disagree

nodes.title: LLM-Based AppropriatenessRule Authoring with HITL Review Queue
nodes.description: Two-file implementation: GuidanceRuleGenerator uses the existing run_consensus() dual-model pipeline to generate AppropriatenessRule candidates from Recommendation nodes, SNOMED-codes each criterion via the terminology API, and writes draft rules (status: pending_review) to Neo4j with associated HITL ReviewTask nodes. FastAPI router exposes fire-and-track generation, list/detail/ decision review endpoints. All LLM call sites comply with llm-security.mdc.

nodes.title: Pathway Explorer research API and GDS services
nodes.description: Implements the backend for the Pathway Explorer research workspace. Consists of four modules:  1. gds_projection_manager.py -- Creates, caches, and drops four named GDS    in-memory projections (patient-condition, condition-cooccur,    patient-journey, referral-network) with org-scoped Cypher projections    and a data-gate check for the referral-network Layer B projection.  2. algorithm_runner.py -- Maps mission IDs to GDS algorithm calls. Handles    Leiden (groups), KNN (similar), PageRank (critical), Betweenness    (bridges), Degree (busiest), Shortest Path / temporal (bottleneck), WCC    (gaps), SCC (circles), Triangle Count (teams), Adamic-Adar (missing).    Returns AlgorithmResult dataclass with headline, items, coverage info,    method text, and guided next steps.  3. headline_generator.py -- Plain-English headline templates and method    text (plain + technical) for each mission. Complies with health literacy    rules (Flesch-Kincaid Grade <= 6).  4. research.py router -- FastAPI router exposing projection management and    mission execution endpoints. Inline missions return 200; async missions    return 202 with run_id.  5. research_worker/ -- Dedicated FastAPI worker service (port 8007) that    executes async missions in background threads with Redis pub/sub progress    events and 7-day Redis job persistence.

nodes.title: Operations workspace inclusive redesign
nodes.description: The Operations workspace is the staff landing page for managing, improving, and monitoring the AI. This output rewrites the workspace to:  - Render a PageIntro block explaining why / how / what,   keyed to 'admin-operations', with copy at Flesch-Kincaid   Grade <=9. - Delete the local components/operations/StatusDot.tsx and   migrate every consumer in   services/ui/src/components/operations/ to the shared   components/ui/StatusDot which encodes status by colour   AND shape. - Keep the existing section-row ARIA pattern   (aria-expanded, aria-controls, role='region') and verify   focus ring visibility passes WCAG AA non-text contrast.

nodes.title: Multi-label NER schema mapper and post-processing normalisation
nodes.description:
Retrospective DO documenting `libs/ner/schema_mapper.py` (VALID_RELATION_TYPES, stable entity-id hashing that keys on (doc_id, start, end, label) so same-span differing-label entities are both retained) and `libs/pipeline/post_processing.py` normalisation, which together give the runtime + training paths one entity per span-label pair.

Gap (tracked in improvements-backlog batch-04): dedupe does not branch on lookup_term when two same-(start,end,label) entries differ on clinical qualifier; and LLM scope guard does not enforce per-document subset against NER label set.

nodes.title: DO-LEO-AI-526: libs/search/term_expansion + cypher $terms branch + training router wiring
nodes.description: Implementation for DI-LEO-AI-526. New libs/search/__init__.py + libs/search/term_expansion.py expose TYPO_MAP, SYNONYM_MAP, normalise_tokens(raw_query), and expand_search_terms(query) -- a deterministic, dependency-free Python module that mirrors services/ui/src/components/mission-control/encounterRelevance.ts. services/analytics_api/app/services/encounter_query_understanding.py is refactored to import the same maps and helpers from this module so the host search and the dry-run review queue cannot drift. libs/cypher/training_candidate_queries.py::GET_TRAINING_CANDIDATES_PAGE + COUNT_TRAINING_CANDIDATES_PAGE and libs/cypher/gold_label_queries.py::GET_GOLD_LABELS_PAGE + COUNT_GOLD_LABELS_PAGE accept an optional $terms array; the WHERE clause uses ANY(t IN $terms WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS t) and a CASE fallback to the prior $search CONTAINS so existing callers stay byte-for-byte compatible. services/api/app/routers/training.py::list_training_candidates / list_gold_labels / _fetch_dedupe_candidates compute terms = expand_search_terms(search) and forward terms=terms to BOTH the page query and the count query in the same request. services/neo4j_mcp/tools/training.py mirrors the wiring. services/api/app/services/candidate_prune.py, services/api/app/routers/pipeline.py, and services/pipeline_worker/app/main.py pass terms=[] to the new signature without changing behaviour.

nodes.title: DI-LEO-AI-526: Server-side search term expansion for the dry-run review queue
nodes.description: The /admin/training Candidates and Gold-label review-queue endpoints (GET /api/training/candidates and GET /api/training/gold-labels) SHALL expand the reviewer's free-text search query using the same deterministic typo and synonym vocabulary as the host encounter search on /care/encounters before the cypher filter is applied, so a query for 'lump' surfaces TrainingCandidate / GoldLabel rows that wrote 'mass', 'swelling', or 'nodule' in the same single page. A new pure-Python helper libs/search/term_expansion.py SHALL hold the single source of truth for the typo correction map (TYPO_MAP), synonym map (SYNONYM_MAP), and an expand_search_terms(query) function. The analytics-layer encounter_query_understanding.py SHALL be refactored to import the same maps and helper from this module. GET_TRAINING_CANDIDATES_PAGE / COUNT_TRAINING_CANDIDATES_PAGE / GET_GOLD_LABELS_PAGE / COUNT_GOLD_LABELS_PAGE SHALL accept an optional $terms parameter (lower-case array). When non-empty, the cypher OR-matches via ANY(t IN $terms WHERE toLower(c.text) CONTAINS t); when empty/NULL, falls back to the legacy $search substring filter via CASE for backward compatibility. The training router and neo4j_mcp tools SHALL forward the expanded terms to both page and count queries on the same request. Mirrors DI-LEO-AI-520 and DI-LEO-AI-523 (UN-LEO-AI-096).

nodes.title: Programme Configuration Registry
nodes.description: Manages clinical audit programme configurations as graph data in Neo4j. Supports creation, validation, activation, and deactivation of programme configurations including clinical domain definitions, milestone types, guideline rule sets, quality targets, and pipeline workflow definitions. All programme-specific logic is stored as data, not code, enabling new audit programmes to be deployed through configuration changes only.

nodes.title: Admin Guard and ReDoS-Safe Regex Validation in Training Router
nodes.description: Hardened services/api/app/routers/training.py implementing four security controls for clinical rule mutation endpoints:  1. ADMIN-ONLY ACCESS: All four mutation endpoints now carry    Depends(require_admin) as a FastAPI parameter dependency:      - POST   /training/post-processor-rules      - PATCH  /training/post-processor-rules/{rule_id}      - POST   /training/context-rules      - PATCH  /training/context-rules/{rule_id}/deactivate    Non-admin requests return HTTP 403 before any business logic runs.  2. REDOS-SAFE REGEX VALIDATION: _validate_regex(pattern, max_length=200)    is called for all user-supplied context_regex inputs:      - Length check: > 200 chars -> HTTP 422      - Syntax check: re.compile() failure -> HTTP 422      - ReDoS probe: subprocess.run() with two pathological probe strings        (_REDOS_PROBE_LOWER = "a"*38, _REDOS_PROBE_SIMPLE = "a"*50+"b")        and 0.5s OS-level timeout -> HTTP 422 on TimeoutExpired  3. LITERAL VALIDATION: ConText rule literals capped at 200 characters;    empty strings rejected with HTTP 422.  4. AUDIT TRAIL HARDENING: created_by is always set from scope.email    (server-verified session identity), never from the request body.

nodes.title: Entity provenance and audit-trail surface
