userNeed.title: Developer maintaining a product built on LEO Core AI needs a predictable versioning and deprecation policy to plan upgrade work
userNeed.description: As a developer maintaining a product built on LEO Core AI, I need a predictable versioning and deprecation policy, so I can plan upgrade work without being surprised by breaking changes or forced into emergency remediations.

designInputs.title: LEO UI design tokens and accessible theme foundation
designInputs.description: The LEO UI SHALL expose a single, typed, tokenised design system (colour pairs, type scale, spacing scale, radius scale, motion scale, focus ring) that every surface consumes through MUI theme and matching CSS custom properties. Tokens MUST guarantee a minimum 16px base body font size, a minimum 12px chip/caption size, >=4.5:1 text contrast, >=3:1 non-text contrast, a >=3px visible focus ring with >=3:1 contrast, and MUST support prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-color-scheme at the CSS custom-property level so any component can adapt without duplicating logic.

designInputs.title: LEO UI density modes (Compact, Comfortable, Spacious) with patient-route safe defaults
designInputs.description: The LEO UI SHALL expose three density modes - Compact, Comfortable (default for staff), and Spacious (default for patient-reachable routes) - controlled by a DensityProvider React context whose value is driven by a user preference persisted to the browser (localStorage key leo-density) and read at app-root. Every primitive component (Button, Chip, Input, Table row, ListItem, Card) MUST resolve its padding, min-height, and font-size from the active density tier. Patient-reachable routes under /portal, /mail, /safety-netting, /games, /care/wellbeing, and /sign-in MUST default to Spacious. Spacious MUST guarantee >=44x44 CSS pixel touch targets.

designInputs.title: Five reusable explanation primitives (PageIntro, HelpPopover, CoachMark, ProgressiveReveal, GlossaryTerm)
designInputs.description: The LEO UI SHALL expose five reusable explanation primitives (PageIntro, HelpPopover, CoachMark, ProgressiveReveal, GlossaryTerm) that every screen consumes to answer, for the current persona, (a) Why am I here, (b) How do I do the task, (c) What will happen next. GlossaryTerm MUST read its definition from a single source-of-truth glossary keyed by clinical term. All patient-reachable copy rendered through these primitives MUST be written at Flesch-Kincaid Grade level 9 or below.

designInputs.title: Semantic versioning policy with published deprecation notices
designInputs.description: The platform SHALL publish and follow semantic versioning for public APIs, announce deprecations with at least the minimum notice period, and maintain a compatibility matrix per release.

designInputs.title: Deprecation and sunset response headers with integrator notification subscription for deprecated endpoints
designInputs.description: The system SHALL include `Deprecation` and `Sunset` response headers on all deprecated endpoints, and SHALL provide a notification subscription mechanism for integrators to receive deprecation announcements without active API monitoring.

designOutputs.title: DensityProvider and density-aware primitive resolution
designOutputs.description: - DensityContext exports a React context with value   'compact' | 'comfortable' | 'spacious' and a setter. - DensityProvider decides the initial value using route-match   (patient-reachable prefixes) + localStorage + default. - useDensity() returns the current value; useDensityTokens()   returns the padding/min-height/font-size map for the   active tier from theme/tokens.ts DENSITY_MAP. - Settings page exposes a Density toggle; writes to   localStorage 'leo-density' and updates context. - Patient-reachable routes (/portal, /mail, /safety-netting,   /games, /care/wellbeing, /sign-in) force 'spacious'.

designOutputs.title: AppShell + primitive a11y fixes + CI a11y gate
designOutputs.description: AppShell.tsx:   - aria-current='page' on the active ListItemButton in     BOTH rail and full drawer modes.   - Logo rendered as a <button> with aria-label; Tooltip     remains for sighted users.   - OrgSelect wrapped in an InputLabel + aria-label, no     placeholder-only state. ConfirmDialog.tsx:   - aria-labelledby on title, aria-describedby on body. StatusDot.tsx:   - Adds an optional icon slot and renders a shape     (circle/triangle/square) tied to status so colour is     not the sole indicator. TermSearch.tsx:   - TextField label 'Search SNOMED terms' replaces     placeholder-only. eslint.config.js:   - Adds eslint-plugin-jsx-a11y recommended rules. e2e/a11y-baseline.spec.ts:   - @axe-core/playwright scan on a representative     patient-reachable route; fails on critical/serious.

designOutputs.title: Token source of truth for LEO UI: theme.ts, theme/tokens.ts, theme/tokens.css
designOutputs.description: - theme/tokens.ts exports TYPE_SCALE, SPACING, RADIUS, MOTION,   FOCUS_RING, and CONTRAST_PAIRS objects. Each pair is a   {fg, bg, role} triplet with >=4.5:1 computed contrast. - theme.ts consumes tokens.ts, adds h1..h6 typography   overrides with minimum 16px body, and enables focus-visible   outlines that meet size and contrast. - theme/tokens.css emits each token as a CSS custom property   under :root and inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion:   reduce) to zero non-essential animation duration and   inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) to swap colour   pairs. It is imported once in layout.tsx. - layout.tsx sets html.lang and html.dir; globals.css keeps   print rules, removes the hardcoded 14px from .skip-link,   adds prefers-reduced-motion overrides.

designOutputs.title: Data Quality Toolkit -- Service Layer, API Router, MCP Server, and Admin UI
designOutputs.description: Implementation of the DQ toolkit across four layers:  1. libs/dq/ service layer: Pydantic-modelled functions for patient    inspection, episode health, outcome inference, terminology audit,    coding quality, domain coverage, remediation (dry-run default), and    an ISO-25012-aligned rules engine with YAML-configurable checks.  2. FastAPI router at /admin/dq/* gated by require_admin, delegating    all logic to libs/dq/ service functions.  3. Cursor MCP server (stdio) exposing read-only DQ tools, calling the    core API over HTTP with admin credentials.  4. Next.js admin UI at /admin/data-quality with a traffic-light    scorecard landing page, drill-down pages per domain (episodes,    terminology, domain, coding, patient inspector, sitrep), and a    confirmation-first remediation UX pattern.

userNeed.title: Clinical coders need free-text encounter narratives automatically coded to SNOMED CT
userNeed.description: As a clinical coder reviewing AI outputs, I need free-text clinical narratives to be automatically coded to SNOMED CT with confidence scores, negation detection, and assertion context — present, historical, family history, suspected — so that manual coding time is reduced and AI proposals can be efficiently verified or corrected rather than coded from scratch.

designInputs.title: Terminology hybrid retrieval skips vector search only when top lexical score >= 0.7
designInputs.description: The CodingResolver SHALL run the vector-search branch whenever the top lexical score (exact + fulltext merged) is below a configurable threshold, defaulting to 0.70 (TERMINOLOGY_VECTOR_SKIP_SCORE). The vector branch SHALL be skipped only when the top lexical score meets or exceeds the threshold, OR when TERMINOLOGY_ENABLE_VECTOR=false. This rule SHALL apply to both the batched resolve() path and the single-term _resolve_single() path.

designInputs.title: Per-semantic-tag tier thresholds with extractor-confidence fusion
designInputs.description: The tier classifier SHALL apply per-semantic-tag tier-1 and tier-2 score thresholds (e.g. disorder: 0.92/0.70, finding: 0.93/0.70, default: 0.95/0.70) and SHALL compute an effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence). Tier 1 SHALL additionally require extractor_confidence >= 0.80 (TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR). Entities where assertion_parity_failed or disorder_verdict == GATE_FAILED SHALL be demoted to tier 2 regardless of effective_score.

designInputs.title: Assertion context label and evidence display on SNOMED coding review card
designInputs.description: The system SHALL display the assertion context label (present, negated, historical, family history, suspected), assertion confidence score, and triggering text window for each SNOMED coding proposal on the reviewer's coding card.

designInputs.title: Terminology index match verifier with mode-aware fail behaviour
designInputs.description: The system SHALL verify terminology index matches using dual-model consensus, returning correct, incorrect, or uncertain -- with mode-aware fail behaviour: autonomous mode defaults to uncertain (do not auto-code unverified matches), HITL mode defaults to correct (let human review)

designInputs.title: Dual-model consensus with Sonnet arbitration for safety-critical decisions
designInputs.description: The system SHALL verify safety-critical clinical decisions using dual-model consensus: two independent LLM providers (AWS Haiku, Azure GPT-5 mini) run in parallel and a larger model (AWS Sonnet) arbitrates when they disagree

designInputs.title: SNOMED coding accuracy quality gate: minimum F1 0.85 on gold-standard dataset
designInputs.description: The system SHALL measure NER-to-SNOMED coding accuracy as F1 on a frozen gold-standard dataset at each model release and SHALL enforce a minimum F1 quality gate of 0.85 that blocks production promotion of any coding model that fails this threshold.

designInputs.title: Disorder verifier classifies active/informational/historical/uncertain with mode-aware fail-safe
designInputs.description: The system SHALL classify disorder entities as active_diagnosis, informational, historical, or uncertain using dual-model consensus, with mode-aware fail-safe behaviour: HITL mode defaults to active_diagnosis (human will review), autonomous mode defaults to uncertain (do not code without confirmation)

designInputs.title: LLM fallback method labelling and threshold configuration for NER coding proposals
designInputs.description: The system SHALL label every NER-extracted entity with a machine-readable extraction method field (ner_primary, ner_with_llm_fallback, llm_only) and SHALL surface this label prominently on the reviewer's coding card; the LLM fallback threshold SHALL be configurable per programme.

designInputs.title: Configurable single-vs-dual-model LLM consensus runner
designInputs.description: The consensus runner used by the disorder gate and coding-verifier steps SHALL support two modes: (1) single-model (default) - one AWS Bedrock call at the configured tier with a strict-reminder parse-retry on parse failure; (2) dual-model (opt-in via CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) - AWS small-tier and Azure small-tier judges run in parallel, an AWS big-tier arbitrator resolves disagreement or single-provider failure. The runner SHALL fail-closed by returning the caller-supplied fail_verdict when all providers fail.

designInputs.title: NER-to-SNOMED entity extraction with confidence score and full provenance metadata
designInputs.description: The system SHALL extract clinical entities from free text using a NER model and link each entity to a SNOMED CT concept with a confidence score, character span, semantic type, and extraction model version; entities below the confidence threshold SHALL be explicitly routed for disambiguation rather than silently dropped.

designInputs.title: FHIR R4 compliant API for all patient record ingestion and audit result export
designInputs.description: The system SHALL retrieve all patient clinical records exclusively via a FHIR R4 compliant API, and SHALL export audit results and pipeline outputs as FHIR resources, so that all patient data exchange uses a standards-based interface that does not depend on proprietary source system integrations.

designInputs.title: Disorder gate fail-closed with GATE_FAILED verdict
designInputs.description: The disorder verifier SHALL record a DisorderVerdict.GATE_FAILED result on any provider failure, parse failure, or consensus disagreement that cannot be resolved. When GATE_FAILED is raised the entity SHALL be marked __needs_review__ and __gate_failed__ and SHALL NOT be eligible for autonomous coding in any mode (HITL, autonomous, or unknown). The verdict SHALL also be recorded on the entity as disorder_verdict for downstream audit.

designInputs.title: Analytics filters exclude non-confirmed assertions from CCI and cohort filters
designInputs.description: The system SHALL exclude coded clinical entities with a non-confirmed assertion (i.e. assertions other than present or historical) from all analytics computations, including Charlson Comorbidity Index (CCI) scoring and cohort condition/smoking-status filters. A coalesce guard SHALL treat a missing assertion as present.

designInputs.title: HITL gate: SNOMED coding proposals require individual reviewer decision before entering final audit data
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce that no AI-generated SNOMED coding proposal can be written to the final audit dataset, exported, or consumed by any downstream product unless a qualified reviewer has individually accepted or rejected that proposal; this gate SHALL be enforced at the API layer and SHALL be immutably logged.

designOutputs.title: FHIR R4 API Service
designOutputs.description: A set of FastAPI routers that expose FHIR R4-compliant endpoints for Measure, MeasureReport, Library, and Device resources. These endpoints allow external audit programme systems to discover available quality measures, submit measure reports, and retrieve supporting library and device metadata. A dedicated Cypher generator translates FHIR search parameters into Neo4j queries so the graph database can serve as the backing store.

designOutputs.title: Dual-Model Consensus Runner Module
designOutputs.description: Generic dual-model consensus runner that calls two independent LLM providers (AWS Haiku, Azure GPT-5 mini) in parallel. If both agree, the shared verdict is returned. If they disagree, Sonnet (AWS big) arbitrates. If all calls fail, a caller-supplied fail_verdict is returned. The module is provider-agnostic via parse_fn and fail_verdict parameters.

designOutputs.title: NER + SNOMED coding surface with assertion handling
designOutputs.description: Umbrella DO for UN-0374FE26 SNOMED coding core. Components: libs/ner NER pipeline (DI-1795254D, DI-4247C7E5), libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs SNOMED linker and assertion layer (DI-31126C6C, DI-375C7EB1), libs/pipeline/post_processing.py 9-layer post-processing, services/coding_worker runtime pipeline. Code-gap flagged in improvements-backlog: gold F1 evaluator for DI-12015DBC and per-semantic-tag threshold drift monitoring for DI-88C8BBCD.

designOutputs.title: Appointment Header Filter and Resolver Input Normalisation
designOutputs.description: Two complementary precision improvements to the clinical coding pipeline:  1. Appointment/admin header filter (DI-LEO-AI-080):    is_header_sentence(text) detects administrative header lines using    a conservative regex and filter_header_sentences(chunks) removes    them from the sentence list before any extractor is called.  2. Resolver input normalisation (DI-LEO-AI-004 bug fix):    _normalise_for_resolve(text) strips trailing numeric lab values    plus SI units (e.g. "1.05 mmol/L") and EMIS local code suffixes    (e.g. "(X78gA)") from evidence phrases before they are sent to    /terminology/resolve, preventing the resolver from returning unit    qualifier concepts instead of the intended lab test concepts.

designOutputs.title: Tier classifier v2 (libs/coding_engine/tier_classifier.py + post_processing integration)
designOutputs.description: Tier classifier enhanced with _TierThresholds dataclass and per-semantic-tag _TIER_THRESHOLDS map, effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence), TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.80, and new demotion rules for assertion_parity_failed and disorder_verdict='gate_failed'. Post-processing stack in libs/pipeline/post_processing.py snapshots the LLM-assigned assertion and applies the parity check after all deterministic layers. Tier-classify subgraph in libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/tier_classify.py passes the new fields to classify_tier().

designOutputs.title: Disorder verifier v2 with fail-closed GATE_FAILED verdict (libs/llm_client/disorder_verifier.py)
designOutputs.description: DisorderVerdict enum extended with GATE_FAILED member. _fail_verdict_for_mode() simplified to return GATE_FAILED for all modes (HITL, autonomous, unknown). verify_disorder() records disorder_verdict on the entity, and on GATE_FAILED sets __needs_review__=True and __gate_failed__=True to prevent silent auto-coding. Post-processing stack handles GATE_FAILED explicitly in _apply_disorder_gate.

designOutputs.title: Coding resolver vector-skip threshold (services/terminology_api/app/services/coding_resolver.py)
designOutputs.description: CodingResolver updated with _top_lexical_score() and _vector_skip_score() helpers and a TERMINOLOGY_VECTOR_SKIP_SCORE env knob defaulting to 0.70. Both resolve() and _resolve_single() now include a term in vector_needed unless its top merged lexical score meets or exceeds skip_score. Preserves TERMINOLOGY_ENABLE_VECTOR=false global kill-switch.

designOutputs.title: Disorder verifier fail-closed with explicit GATE_FAILED verdict
designOutputs.description: - DisorderVerdict enum gains ``GATE_FAILED = "gate_failed"``. - ``_fail_verdict_for_mode`` returns ``gate_failed`` in both HITL   and autonomous modes (and any unknown mode). - ``verify_disorder`` writes ``disorder_verdict`` on the entity   dict for downstream layers and, on GATE_FAILED, sets   ``__needs_review__=True`` and ``__gate_failed__=True``. - The post-processing disorder-gate layer recognises GATE_FAILED   and routes the entity to review rather than auto-suppress or   auto-code.

designOutputs.title: Disorder Entity Verifier Module
designOutputs.description: Classifies disorder entities as active_diagnosis, informational, historical, or uncertain using dual-model consensus. Mode-aware fail-safe behaviour ensures HITL mode defaults to active_diagnosis (surface for human review) and autonomous mode defaults to uncertain (do not code). Handles LLM output parsing including markdown-wrapped JSON and embedded JSON objects.

designOutputs.title: Consensus runner v2 (libs/llm_client/consensus.py)
designOutputs.description: Rewritten consensus runner with two honest execution modes. Default single-model path issues one AWS Bedrock call with a strict-reminder parse-retry. Opt-in dual-model path (CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true) runs AWS small + Azure small in parallel with AWS big arbitration on disagreement or single-provider failure. Fail-closed when all providers fail. Docstring updated to reflect actual behaviour. Consumed by disorder verifier and coding-verifier call sites without caller-side changes.

designOutputs.title: fix_polarity_encoded_findings guard in post_processing.py and terminology.py
designOutputs.description: Adds fix_polarity_encoded_findings() to libs/pipeline/post_processing.py. The function iterates over resolved entities and, for any entity whose semantic_tag is "finding" or "observable entity" and whose SNOMED preferred term matches _POLARITY_SUFFIX_RE (ends with "absent", "not detected", "not found", "not present", or "negative" before the semantic tag parenthesis), forces assertion="present" and sets _assertion_guard="polarity_encoded_finding".  Called from two locations:   1. post_processing.py layer 7d (_run_double_neg_guards), after      fix_double_negated_situations, for the training path.   2. terminology.py _resolve_terms, after fix_double_negated_situations,      for the runtime coding pipeline.  This closes the gap where the existing double-negation guard handles only situation concepts with prefix-negated PTs. Finding concepts encode polarity as a suffix word; this guard handles that pattern.

designOutputs.title: Coding Verification Consensus Function
designOutputs.description: Verifies terminology index matches using dual-model consensus, returning correct, incorrect, or uncertain. Mode-aware fail behaviour: autonomous defaults to uncertain (do not auto-approve), HITL defaults to correct (let human review). Reuses the generic consensus runner (DO-LEO-AI-023) with a domain-specific system prompt and verdict parser.

designOutputs.title: Assertion-aware analytics queries for CCI and cohort filters
designOutputs.description: Adds a _CONFIRMED_ASSERTIONS constant (frozenset{"present","historical"}) to both cci.py and cohorts.py. Every Cypher query that traverses a [:DOCUMENTS] relationship now aliases it as [r:DOCUMENTS] and includes:    AND coalesce(r.assertion, 'present') IN $assertions  (CCI)   AND coalesce(r.assertion, 'present') IN $confirmed_assertions  (cohorts)  The coalesce guard preserves backwards compatibility: encounters created before assertion tracking was introduced carry no assertion property and are treated as 'present'.  'historical' is included in confirmed assertions because CCI is a lifetime comorbidity index (e.g. a previous stroke still counts). Cohort filtering also includes 'historical' so ex-smoker SNOMED codes correctly match the ever_smoker filter.

designOutputs.title: run_consensus: single-model default, optional dual-model consensus
designOutputs.description: Rewrite of libs/llm_client/consensus.py that aligns the controlled design with the production implementation and adds a feature-flagged dual-model path. Default mode runs a single AWS Bedrock call with parse-retry; ``CONSENSUS_DUAL_MODEL=true`` enables AWS + Azure small parallel calls with a big-tier AWS arbitrator on disagreement.

designOutputs.title: Per-semantic-tag tier thresholds, extractor confidence fusion, and assertion parity gating
designOutputs.description: Updates to the three-tier decision engine and post-processing stack:  - classify_tier accepts semantic_tag, extractor_confidence, and   assertion_parity_failed and uses a per-tag thresholds table   (disorder 0.92, finding/situation 0.93, procedure 0.94,   substance/product/observable 0.96-0.97; default 0.95). - effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence)   with a hard floor (0.80) below which tier-1 is blocked with reason   ``low_extractor_confidence``. - A new assertion_parity snapshot in post_processing records the   LLM's original assertion before the deterministic layers run, and   compares it against the final assertion after the stack   completes. Disagreements set ``assertion_parity_failed=True``,   which caps the tier gate at tier 2 with reason ``assertion_parity``. - tier_classify subgraph passes all three new arguments through to   classify_tier.

userNeed.title: Downstream products need LEO Core AI clinical outputs exposed as standard FHIR R4 resources conformant to UK Core profiles
userNeed.description: As a developer building a downstream Mizaic product, I need LEO Core AI outputs to be consumable as standard FHIR R4 resources so that integration does not require custom adapters and the system can be included in a downstream IEC 62304 system context document.

designInputs.title: FHIR: capability statement at /fhir/metadata and CI FHIR validator against UK Core profiles
designInputs.description: The system SHALL publish a FHIR capability statement at GET /fhir/metadata, and SHALL run the FHIR validator against all generated FHIR resources as a blocking CI step, validating conformance against UK Core profiles for Observation and EpisodeOfCare.

designInputs.title: FHIR R4: coded findings as Observation, milestones as EpisodeOfCare, audit results as MeasureReport with meta.source provenance

designOutputs.title: FHIR R4 API Service
designOutputs.description: A set of FastAPI routers that expose FHIR R4-compliant endpoints for Measure, MeasureReport, Library, and Device resources. These endpoints allow external audit programme systems to discover available quality measures, submit measure reports, and retrieve supporting library and device metadata. A dedicated Cypher generator translates FHIR search parameters into Neo4j queries so the graph database can serve as the backing store.

userNeed.title: Operations teams need continuous coding quality monitoring with automated regression alerts
userNeed.description: As an operations team member responsible for deployed NLP model quality, I need continuous automated monitoring of coding quality over time with alerts when regressions occur, so that I can act on deteriorating model performance before it affects the quality of patient data and audit outputs.

designInputs.title: Coding quality metrics trend dashboard with 30-cycle history and threshold reference lines
designInputs.description: The system SHALL display a quality metrics trend dashboard showing time-series charts of coding quality metrics across monitoring cycles, with configurable threshold reference lines and data point drill-down.

designInputs.title: Surface form revocation with cascade CodingReview creation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a surface form revocation endpoint that removes a MAPS_TO relationship, marks the SurfaceFormTask as revoked, and creates CodingReview nodes for every encounter coded after the surface form's first_used_at date where a DOCUMENTS relationship uses the revoked concept with source=provisional, so that affected records can be corrected or confirmed by a reviewer.

designInputs.title: Overcoded encounter urgent review queue with SLA and escalation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL surface overcoded encounters detected by the quality monitoring cycle into a dedicated urgent review queue, with SLA timestamps and escalation notifications for unacknowledged items.

designInputs.title: Per-programme AI processing kill switch activatable without code deployment
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a per-programme kill switch that, when activated, halts all new AI processing runs for that programme without requiring a code deployment, with activation and clearance immutably audit-logged.

designInputs.title: Quality regression alert escalation with automatic pipeline pause on unacknowledged threshold breach
designInputs.description: The system SHALL implement a multi-stage alert escalation sequence for coding quality regressions that routes unacknowledged alerts to escalating recipients and eventually sets a pipeline pause flag that prevents new processing batches until an administrator clears it.

designInputs.title: Continuous coding quality metrics with regression alerting
designInputs.description: The operations service SHALL compute rolling coding quality metrics on scheduled samples and SHALL raise alerts when any metric crosses configured regression thresholds.

designOutputs.title: Overcoded CodingReview Creation with Urgent Queue and 48h SLA Alert
designOutputs.description: Audit Phase 3 identifies overcoded items. Each overcoded item creates a CodingReview node with review_type='overcoded' and priority='urgent'. These appear in a dedicated urgent section in the ReviewSection UI above the general queue. A background check creates a SafetyNetAlert if any urgent item remains unreviewed after 48 hours.

designOutputs.title: Surface Form Revoke Endpoint with Cascade CodingReview Creation
designOutputs.description: Implements DELETE /training/surface-forms/{normalized}/revoke. Removes MAPS_TO, marks SurfaceFormTask as revoked, queries all encounters coded after first_used_at with matching provisional source, and creates CodingReview nodes with review_type='revocation_cascade' in a single transaction. Recently approved terms view with use_count and Revoke button.

designOutputs.title: SafetyNetAlert with Dedup, Escalation, and LoopConfig Kill Switch
designOutputs.description: Implements SafetyNetAlert creation with deduplication (minimum 100 encounters, new critical terms only or >3% drop), time-based escalation (48h/7d/14d), auto-pause at 14d, LoopConfig Neo4j node as kill switch, audit quality API router, and UI notification badge.

designOutputs.title: Audit-quality API and drift analytics surface
designOutputs.description:
Design output documenting `services/api/app/routers/audit_quality.py`, `services/analytics_api/app/routers/audit.py`, `_audit_sections.py`, and `dashboards.py` providing audit/drift metrics endpoints plus the analytics UI surface.

Gaps (batch-13 themes D + E + H): mandatory acknowledgement gate, programme-level kill switch, overcoded-encounter urgent review SLA, 30-cycle dashboard with threshold reference, and root-cause labelling with 2-year immutable history are either missing or partial.

designOutputs.title: Automated Weekly Audit Execution with Immutable AuditRun and DriftMetric
designOutputs.description: Extends the audit script with --since-days flag, deterministic run_id, immutability guard, Neo4j result writer, and per-domain breakdown. Adds AuditRun and DriftMetric schema constraints. Schedules via Azure Container Apps Job at 02:00 UTC Monday on a dedicated audit-jobs queue.

designOutputs.title: Extraction quality LLM check before terminology
designOutputs.description: Adds a relation-linking stage and a single-turn extraction quality check before terminology resolution. The quality check can drop noisy entities, correct assertion and semantic tag fields, add missed clinically explicit mentions, and correct/add relation links for body-site and qualifier context. The check uses a constrained JSON contract and attaches provenance markers for retraining. Referral procedure phrases are protected from uncertain assertion downgrades by a deterministic guard. Conditional routing sends changed extraction payloads to HITL queue.

userNeed.title: Clinical safety officers need the review interface to require active evidence engagement to prevent automation bias
userNeed.description: As a clinical safety officer responsible for the human review gate, I need the review interface to be designed so that reviewers must actively engage with the clinical evidence before they can confirm an AI recommendation — not just acknowledge it — so that the human review step provides genuine clinical oversight rather than becoming a rubber stamp that automation bias reduces to a single click.

designInputs.title: Confirmation state reset on reviewer correction with mandatory re-engagement before re-confirmation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL reset the AI recommendation confirmation state and require reviewer re-engagement whenever a reviewer edits or removes a confirmed finding, ensuring the updated recommendation is reviewed before final confirmation.

designInputs.title: Reviewer engagement metrics logging and clinical safety officer monitoring view for automation bias detection
designInputs.description: The system SHALL log reviewer engagement metrics (time on evidence, findings reviewed, assertion changes, corrections) per review session, and SHALL provide a clinical safety officer monitoring view with low-engagement flags and configurable thresholds.

designInputs.title: Active evidence engagement gate before AI recommendation confirmation with urgency-criterion requirement
designInputs.description: The system SHALL render the AI recommendation confirm button as disabled until a reviewer has performed the configured minimum active evidence engagement actions, with high-urgency recommendations requiring explicit confirmation of the primary urgency criterion.

designInputs.title: RBAC enforcement for all AI output review and finalisation actions
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce role-based access control for all AI output review and finalisation actions, ensuring that no AI-generated entity, episode classification, quality alert, or clinical interpretation can be accepted, edited, or rejected without a user who has an appropriate assigned role performing the action.

userNeed.title: Audit team leads need completed episodes automatically validated for quality issues before reporting
userNeed.description: As an audit team lead, I need completed clinical episodes to be automatically validated for quality issues — duration outliers, missing milestones, temporal anomalies, low-confidence codings, and coding contradictions — so that data quality problems are surfaced and resolved before episodes are used in audit reporting or clinical decisions.

designInputs.title: Episode temporal quality checks: duration outliers, missing milestones, and sequence anomaly detection
designInputs.description: The system SHALL detect and flag episode duration outliers, missing mandatory milestones, and temporal anomalies in milestone event sequences against configurable programme-level thresholds.

designInputs.title: End-to-end single-patient pipeline processing within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile
designInputs.description: The system SHALL complete the full pipeline processing cycle for a single patient — including FHIR record retrieval, NLP entity extraction, guideline evaluation, episode construction, and quality validation — within 10 seconds at the 95th percentile under normal operating conditions.

designInputs.title: Low-confidence entity flagging and intra-episode coding contradiction detection
designInputs.description: The system SHALL surface low-confidence NLP entity classifications and coding contradictions within each episode as quality flags, visible before the episode is used in any reporting or downstream product.

designInputs.title: Episode quality gate: flagged episodes blocked from reporting until flags are resolved
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce a quality gate that prevents any episode with unresolved quality flags from being included in a reporting dataset or exported until a reviewer has explicitly resolved each flag, with all resolutions immutably audit-logged.

designOutputs.title: Episode builder subgraph with classification + DQ
designOutputs.description:
Design output documenting the episode construction + classification surface: `libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/episode.py`, prompts in `libs/prompts/episode_builder_v1.py` and `episode_builder_output_schema.py`, DQ checks in `libs/dq/episodes.py`, tests in `tests/test_episode_builder.py`.

Gaps (batch-14 theme A): BD696225 human-review gate before audit reporting; 736B698B 85% F1 accuracy gate; A0579B64 reporting block on unresolved flags; deterministic construction invariant (FF9C74E2).

designOutputs.title: Three-Stream SurfaceFormTask Creation with Two-Reviewer Gate
designOutputs.description: Implements three input streams feeding SurfaceFormTask nodes. Stream A reads audit gaps. Stream B defers MAPS_TO creation from resolve_coding_review to a SurfaceFormTask pending second approval. Stream C creates tasks from LLM high-confidence terms, capped at 20/day with auto-pause at queue depth 50. Source badge displayed in ReviewCard.

designOutputs.title: NLP training, audit agent, and FHIR exposure surface
designOutputs.description: Umbrella DO for active learning + model improvement cycle, audit agent with bounded auto-fix, benchmark charts in audit exports, FHIR R4 downstream exposure, pathway interval calculations, episode validation, and end-to-end single-patient pipeline SLA. UNs: UN-5236129E, UN-1AC15812, UN-299200A0, UN-94833CA3, UN-5C67AAD9, UN-2C01CF40. Components: libs/training, libs/audit_agent, services/fhir_api, services/coding_worker pipeline.

designOutputs.title: Container Infrastructure
designOutputs.description: Azure Container Apps infrastructure defined as Bicep templates with supporting Dockerfiles for each service. The Bicep modules provision the container environment, Key Vault for secrets, and configure auto-scaling rules. Dockerfiles produce minimal, reproducible images for each ACA service; coding and analysis logic ships inside the pipeline-worker image via shared Python packages (no separate worker images).

designOutputs.title: Three-Tier Decision Engine Module
designOutputs.description: Deterministic decision matrix that classifies each extracted entity into Tier 1 (auto-code), Tier 2 (code with audit flag / review), or Tier 3 (do not code / review) based on assertion, context detection status, terminology confidence, surface form approval, and disorder verdict. Mode-aware routing maps tiers to different actions in HITL vs autonomous mode. Pure function with no side effects.

designInputs.title: OAuth2/OIDC-aligned authentication with documented scopes and token lifetimes

designInputs.title: Isolated test credential environment with per-scope credentials and full OAuth 2.0/OIDC flow support

designOutputs.title: Authentication and Authorisation Module
designOutputs.description: Provides authentication and authorisation for all API endpoints. Validates Entra ID (Azure AD) tokens, enforces organisation-scoped tenancy, and manages service-to-service authentication between internal microservices. Injects tenant context into request dependencies for data isolation.

designOutputs.title: Auth, role-state and tenant-scope middleware
designOutputs.description:
Design output documenting the authN/authZ surface: `libs/auth/role_state.py` (RoleState, canonical role set, selected-role workflow), `libs/auth/tenant_context.py` (tenant scope), `libs/auth/practitioner_org_context.py` (clinician-org binding), `libs/auth/service_auth.py`, `libs/auth/org_scope.py`, and `services/api/app/routers/auth.py`. Azure Key Vault-backed secrets (`libs/keyvault/loader.py`, `libs/azure/credentials.py`).

Gaps (batch-15 Theme B/C): formalised token lifecycle documentation (UN-A031A603), explicit conflict-of-interest attestation artefact per review (UN-17724530), and physical database-level tenant separation (UN-412D1ECD currently implemented as logical tenant-scoped Cypher rather than per-tenant DB). Backlogged.

userNeed.description: As an NLP engineer, I need encounter classification rules and the classification model to be manageable via the platform, so that encounter eligibility decisions for each audit programme are auditable and improvable without code changes.

designInputs.title: Encounter classification: misclassification labelling feedback loop and model registry integration
designInputs.description: The system SHALL allow misclassified encounters to be flagged as labelled training examples directly from the classification review interface, add them to the training corpus, and manage the classification model version through the model registry with the same canary promotion workflow applied to the NER model.

designInputs.title: Encounter classification: managed rules with per-encounter decision persistence and test-pass gate
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a management interface for encounter classification rules covering keyword triggers, programme assignment, confidence threshold, and fallback behaviour, persisting every classification decision with encounter ID, matched rule, confidence score, and model version, and requiring a test pass before any rule change is activated.

designInputs.title: FHIR PlanDefinition/ActivityDefinition pathway orchestration
designInputs.description: The system SHALL orchestrate clinical pathways using FHIR PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition resources as the canonical workflow definition format, enabling pathway steps to be defined, versioned, and executed in a standards-compliant manner.

designInputs.title: LangGraph pipeline executor with PlanDefinition-driven subgraph dispatch
designInputs.description: The system SHALL execute pipelines defined as directed workflow graphs using a LangGraph-based pipeline with FHIR PlanDefinition-driven subgraph dispatch, dispatching each step to the appropriate worker service via message bus, supporting branching, conditional edges, fan-out/fan-in patterns, and cross-pipeline triggers

designInputs.title: Production coding worker uses WorkflowEngine + encounter_loader subgraph
designInputs.description: The production coding worker SHALL execute coding jobs through the WorkflowEngine using PlanDefinition pd-gp-encounter-coding for all coding modes (extract_encounter, extract_patient, and all). Encounter narrative text SHALL NOT be transported in queue message payloads and SHALL instead be loaded at runtime from Neo4j by a dedicated encounter_loader subgraph step before extraction.

designInputs.title: Unified pipeline-jobs queue with PipelineJobMessage dispatch and progress events
designInputs.description: The system SHALL consume pipeline job messages from a single pipeline-jobs queue using unified PipelineJobMessage format (Azure Service Bus / Redis Streams), dispatch them to the appropriate worker service, track job state, and publish progress events

designOutputs.title: Pipeline Orchestration Service
designOutputs.description: Orchestrates the end-to-end clinical coding and analysis pipeline. Manages job lifecycle from submission through coding, analysis, and completion. Dispatches work to coding and analysis workers via the message bus, tracks job progress, and handles retries and failures.

designOutputs.title: Unified Pipeline Worker Service
designOutputs.description: A single worker service that consumes from the pipeline-jobs queue, processes unified PipelineJobMessage payloads, and executes pipeline steps by dispatching to the appropriate subgraph handlers. Replaces separate coding_worker and analysis_worker job handlers with one unified service backed by LangGraph and FHIR PlanDefinition-driven orchestration.

designOutputs.title: Rule-based encounter pre-classification with ClassificationResult persistence
designOutputs.description:
Design output documenting `libs/classifiers/encounter_classifier.py` and `libs/classifiers/encounter_textcat.py`: deterministic phrase + regex classification into admin_only / document_transfer / clinical. Encounter text is never sent to an LLM (mitigates prompt injection threat NER-T-001). Persists `ClassificationResult` with content_type, domains, encounter_purpose, key_clinical_signals, expected_semantic_tags, clinical_significance, and consensus metadata.

Gaps (improvements-backlog batch-12, DI-8CE01B3E partial + DI-0ADE6A8E partial): no management UI for keyword triggers/programme assignment/confidence threshold; no test-pack gate before rule activation; no explicit misclassification-as-training-example flag; no model-registry hook for classification model versioning.

designOutputs.title: Production Coding Worker WorkflowEngine Routing
designOutputs.description: Implements production cutover from CodingPipeline to WorkflowEngine for coding jobs. Adds encounter_loader subgraph to hydrate encounter text from Neo4j during runtime, removes encounter text from queue payloads, and keeps SSE progress compatibility through Redis pub/sub events.

designOutputs.title: FHIR Workflow Engine
designOutputs.description: Engine that loads FHIR PlanDefinition and ActivityDefinition resources, converts them to executable workflow graphs, and executes pathway steps. Supports dynamicValue expressions for runtime parameter binding. Integrates with LangGraph for subgraph execution and the unified pipeline worker for job dispatch.

userNeed.title: System supports SNOMED CT terminology search, resolution, and value set management
userNeed.description: Clinical audit teams need to search, browse, and manage SNOMED CT terminology within the platform. This includes hybrid concept resolution (exact match, full-text search, and vector similarity), value set creation and management, concept map maintenance, and writeback of new terminology mappings discovered during the audit process. The terminology service operates against the Coding Neo4j database, separate from patient data.

designOutputs.title: Terminology API Service

The service reads from the terminology Neo4j instance and writes corrections back through a controlled writeback pipeline that records provenance and triggers re-evaluation of affected records.

userNeed.description: As a clinician preparing a patient handover or MDT submission, I need a structured SBAR (Situation-Background-Assessment-Recommendation) summary generated from the coded record, so that critical context is communicated consistently without manual reconstruction from individual encounter notes.

designInputs.title: SBAR: AI-generated structured summary from coded encounters, pathway stage, and safety netting alerts
designInputs.description: The system SHALL generate an SBAR-structured clinical summary for a patient by synthesising their coded encounters, current pathway stage, and any outstanding safety netting alerts, using the active LLM prompt for summary generation and labelling all content as AI-generated.

designInputs.title: SBAR: source encounter and coded entity provenance links on every clinical statement
designInputs.description: The system SHALL link each clinical statement in a generated SBAR section to the source encounter node and coded entity from which it was derived, surfacing these provenance links in the SBAR user interface and preserving them in the exported record.

designInputs.title: SBAR: mandatory human review gate before finalisation with AI-original/edit delta record
designInputs.description: The system SHALL require a clinician review step before an SBAR summary is marked as finalised, and SHALL record any edits made during review as a structured delta preserving the original AI-generated text alongside the edited text, with the editor identity and timestamp.

designOutputs.title: CodingDecision Audit Trail Queries
designOutputs.description: Cypher query definitions for the CodingDecision node schema in Neo4j. Every autonomous-mode coding decision is recorded as a CodingDecision node with full provenance: entity, assertion, tier, decision, reason, terminology score, consensus verdict, and model IDs. MERGE semantics ensure idempotent writes. Queries support per-encounter retrieval, aggregate statistics, and audit flag counting.

userNeed.title: Clinical quality reviewers need coded encounters automatically checked against programme guidelines
userNeed.description: As a clinical quality reviewer, I need coded encounter data to be automatically evaluated against programme-defined clinical guideline rules, with deviation alerts generated and prioritised by severity, so that guideline non-compliance is surfaced for my attention rather than requiring manual cross-referencing of coded data against guideline criteria.

designInputs.title: Programme-level guideline rule set configuration without code deployment
designInputs.description: The system SHALL allow programme administrators to define, version, and activate guideline rule sets through configuration management without requiring code changes or a new software deployment; each programme SHALL maintain an independently versioned active rule set.

designInputs.title: Automated guideline conformance evaluation on coded encounters
designInputs.description: The quality engine SHALL evaluate each coded encounter against the active programme rule set, emit severity-scored deviation alerts, and route them to the review queue.

designInputs.title: Human-review gate blocking downstream actions from unreviewed guideline alerts
designInputs.description: The system SHALL block any downstream product action that is triggered by a guideline alert unless a qualified reviewer has recorded an explicit decision against that specific alert; the enforcement SHALL occur at the API layer and SHALL be logged in the immutable audit trail.

designInputs.title: Guideline evaluation completion within 5 seconds per patient at p95
designInputs.description: The system SHALL complete guideline evaluation for a single patient and make resulting alerts available in the reviewer queue within 5 seconds at p95 latency under nominal and defined peak load conditions.

userNeed.title: Clinical content managers need to maintain the ConText assertion rules that determine whether extracted entities are present, absent, or uncertain
userNeed.description: As a clinical content manager, I need to maintain the ConText assertion rules that determine whether extracted entities are present, absent, or uncertain, so that assertion accuracy reflects validated clinical linguistic patterns and can be improved without code changes.

designInputs.title: Assertion parity check between LLM extractor and ConText post-processing
designInputs.description: The post-processing stack SHALL compare the LLM extractor's self-rated assertion (snapshotted at the start of post-processing) with the final assertion determined by ConText and situation-lookup layers, and SHALL set an assertion_parity_failed flag on the entity when they differ. Entities with assertion_parity_failed=true SHALL NOT be eligible for tier 1 auto-coding regardless of terminology score.

designInputs.title: ConText rule management: full parameter CRUD with test-run gate before activation
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a ConText rule management interface covering trigger phrase, assertion type (present, absent, uncertain, historical, family, hypothetical), scope direction, window size, and pseudo-trigger exceptions, requiring a passed verification test run before activation of any rule set change.

designInputs.title: ConText rule change: pre-save assertion distribution impact report against held-out corpus
designInputs.description: The system SHALL compute the assertion distribution impact of a proposed ConText rule change against the held-out test corpus before the change is saved, displaying the delta in assertion type counts relative to the current active rule set and storing the impact report with the change record.

designInputs.title: Staging enrichment uses post-diagnosis window with site-specialty filter
designInputs.description: The staging enrichment subgraph SHALL derive stage only from encounter text inside a fixed post-diagnosis window of STAGING_WINDOW_DAYS days (default 90) starting at the episode's diagnosis_date. Within that window, evidence rows SHALL be filtered through the cancer-site specialty marker for the episode's cancer_type so that TNM, Gleason and explicit stage text belonging to a different concurrent cancer pathway cannot contribute to this episode's stage. If no evidence rows match the specialty marker, the filter SHALL fall back to the unfiltered rows to avoid producing a null stage where the window contained relevant evidence that simply did not mention the site keyword.

designInputs.title: LLM extractor emits self-rated assertion and confidence per entity
designInputs.description: The LLM extractor SHALL emit a self-rated assertion label (present | absent | uncertain | historical | family_history | conditional | hypothetical) and a self-rated confidence score in [0.0, 1.0] for every extracted entity. Values SHALL be parsed, normalised, and clamped, and SHALL be written onto each ExtractedTerm / ExtractionItem for use by downstream tiering and parity checks.

designOutputs.description: Tier classifier enhanced with _TierThresholds dataclass and per-semantic-tag _TIER_THRESHOLDS map, effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence), TIER1_EXTRACTOR_CONFIDENCE_FLOOR=0.80, and new demotion rules for assertion_parity_failed and disorder_verdict='gate_failed'. Post-processing stack in libs/pipeline/post_processing.py snapshots the LLM-assigned assertion and applies the parity check after all deterministic layers. Tier-classify subgraph in libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/tier_classify.py passes the new fields to classify_tier().

designOutputs.title: LLM extractor v2 (prompt + ExtractedTerm/ExtractionItem parser)
designOutputs.description: Updated extraction prompt (libs/prompts/extraction_v1.py) with new CLINICAL QUALIFIER PRESERVATION, ASSERTION, and CONFIDENCE sections. Updated parsers in services/coding_worker/app/pipeline/llm_extractor.py and libs/pipeline_graph/subgraphs/_extractor.py to parse, normalise, and clamp assertion and confidence, resolve absolute spans via SpanResolver, and propagate the new fields onto ExtractedTerm and ExtractionItem records. Added _normalise_assertion and _normalise_confidence helpers.

designOutputs.title: Assertion-free LLM extraction output with post-processing as sole assertion authority
designOutputs.description: The LLM extractor output schema no longer includes an assertion field. Both extraction code paths (_extractor.py build path and llm_extractor.py LLMExtractor) always initialise assertion to "present" after parsing LLM JSON, discarding any assertion value the LLM may have included. The extraction_v1.py system prompt and the _OUTPUT_FORMAT fallback schema do not instruct the LLM to output assertion.  All non-present assertions are assigned downstream by the shared post-processing pipeline (libs/pipeline/post_processing.py):   - Layer 3: scope guard (reclassifies present -> hypothetical/possible)   - Layer 7: ConText MedSpaCy detection (absent, historical, family,     planned, possible, declined, cancelled, hypothetical)   - Layer 7b: referral procedure guard (reverts possible -> present)   - Layer 7d: double-negation situation guard (reverts absent -> present)   - Layer 9: disorder gate (sets historical/refuted/possible for disorders)  This eliminates the one-way error trap where an LLM-assigned non-present assertion could not be corrected by ConText.

designOutputs.title: Per-semantic-tag tier thresholds, extractor confidence fusion, and assertion parity gating
designOutputs.description: Updates to the three-tier decision engine and post-processing stack:  - classify_tier accepts semantic_tag, extractor_confidence, and   assertion_parity_failed and uses a per-tag thresholds table   (disorder 0.92, finding/situation 0.93, procedure 0.94,   substance/product/observable 0.96-0.97; default 0.95). - effective_score = min(terminology_score, extractor_confidence)   with a hard floor (0.80) below which tier-1 is blocked with reason   ``low_extractor_confidence``. - A new assertion_parity snapshot in post_processing records the   LLM's original assertion before the deterministic layers run, and   compares it against the final assertion after the stack   completes. Disagreements set ``assertion_parity_failed=True``,   which caps the tier gate at tier 2 with reason ``assertion_parity``. - tier_classify subgraph passes all three new arguments through to   classify_tier.

designOutputs.title: LLM extractor paths updated for span resolution, self-rated assertion, self-rated confidence, and clinical-qualifier preservation
designOutputs.description: Both LLM extractor implementations (the coding_worker extractor and the WorkflowEngine subgraph extractor) are updated to:  - Call the shared SpanResolver (DO-LEO-AI-110) so every extracted   term carries accurate absolute character offsets into the   encounter text. - Parse the LLM's emitted ``assertion`` value into the   ExtractionItem / ExtractedTerm assertion field, clamping to the   controlled vocabulary and defaulting to ``present`` when missing. - Parse the LLM's self-rated ``confidence`` in [0, 1], clamping to   valid range and defaulting to 1.0 when missing. - Receive updated system prompt instructions that tell the LLM to   preserve clinical qualifiers (onset, chronicity, certainty,   laterality) in the ``lookup_term`` field, and to emit assertion   and confidence as required fields.

designInputs.title: Breast specialty marker recall extension for UK primary-care vocabulary
designInputs.description: SPECIALTY_MARKERS[breast] in libs/clinical_scoping/specialty_markers.py SHALL match every UK-primary-care clinical surface form that reliably indicates the breast pathway, including: triple assessment, breast clinic, nipple discharge, family history of breast cancer, fibroadenoma references, ductal carcinoma, lobular carcinoma, areola, and sentinel lymph node biopsy. The extended regex SHALL achieve >= 90% recall on a corpus of 20 real 2025 breast encounter texts sampled from the dev graph and SHALL NOT falsely match generic chest/thorax/non-breast contexts.

designInputs.title: Two-pass referral matching with strict-then-fallback claim and honest NULL
designInputs.description: The episode builder SHALL match each cancer diagnosis anchor to a preceding referral anchor using a two-pass strategy. Pass 1 keeps current strict same-site behaviour: only a referral whose site key equals the diagnosis site or is non_site_specific may be claimed. Any diagnosis still unmatched after Pass 1 runs through Pass 2, which claims the nearest unclaimed referral within DIAG_LOOKBACK_DAYS regardless of site key, subject to MIN_REFERRAL_TO_DIAG_DAYS. Episodes produced via Pass 2 SHALL be tagged ep.referral_match_method = fallback_any_site so downstream audit surfaces can distinguish strict from fallback claims. When NO referral can be claimed, ep.referral_date SHALL NOT be synthesised from the diagnosis encounter date; it SHALL be persisted as NULL, and ep.referral_inferred SHALL be false.

designInputs.title: IMD deprivation analysis panel for pathway performance with health equity monitoring support
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a deprivation analysis panel segmenting pathway performance by IMD decile, with consistent filtering and cited data sources, to support health equity monitoring.

designOutputs.title: Broadened breast specialty marker
designOutputs.description: Extend SPECIALTY_MARKERS['breast'] in libs/clinical_scoping/specialty_markers.py to cover common UK primary-care surface forms missed by the current regex. The extension focuses on routine clinic referral language that dominates 2WW breast letters and on pathology-confirmation phrasing that appears in diagnosis notes.

designOutputs.title: Analytics Dashboard Service
designOutputs.description: An API layer that serves aggregated metrics, key performance indicators, deprivation-index breakdowns, benchmark comparisons, and cohort summaries to the front-end dashboard. Each router handles a specific analytics domain and queries the patient Neo4j instance for real-time or cached results.

designOutputs.title: libs/analytics/cohorts.py canonical NCDA cohort definition
designOutputs.description: A pure-Cypher-text helper library that returns the single authoritative WHERE / EXISTS clauses used across every NCDA analytics endpoint to identify a 'confirmed cancer episode' and a '2WW-route diagnosis'. No Neo4j session, LLM, or HTTP dependency; consumed by audit.py, _audit_sections.py, _audit_intervals.py, dashboards.py, mission_control.py, and benchmarks.py.

designOutputs.title: /work unified task queue (Cypher UNION, FastAPI, Next.js page, design-system primitive)
designOutputs.description: Implements DI-LEO-AI-138 end-to-end: Cypher UNION across three node labels, Python service that normalises each source into a common task row shape, FastAPI endpoints /work/tasks and /work/counts, TaskQueue primitive in @leo/design-system, and a Next.js /work route that lands staff users on the unified queue.

designOutputs.title: Dashboard and Safety Netting UI
designOutputs.description: Front-end pages and components that present practice-level KPI cards, trend charts, and a safety netting worklist. The dashboard gives clinicians and practice managers an at-a-glance view of coding quality and QOF performance. The safety netting worklist highlights patients whose care episodes may have missing or incorrect clinical codes, allowing clinicians to review and action them.

designOutputs.title: Episode builder fallback referral-claim and evidence-wins merge
designOutputs.description: Two correlated updates to the episode-builder package:  1. Two-pass referral matching: strict same-site Pass 1 followed    by site-agnostic Pass 2 for diagnoses that remain floating.    ep.referral_match_method tags every episode with    'strict_site' | 'fallback_any_site' | 'none'. When Pass 2    still leaves a diagnosis floating, ep.referral_date is    NULL (never back-filled from the diagnosis date) and    ep.referral_inferred is false.  2. Evidence-wins duplicate merging: per-patient referral-date    clustering (including NSS episodes), text corroboration of    cancer_type against the diagnosis_confirmed encounter text,    and a new MOVE_LINKS_Q Cypher query that migrates every    IS_PART_OF edge from duplicates to the primary, preserving    milestone_type.  Together these changes bring the canonical confirmed-cancer count in line with the true patient cohort and raise the 2WW-route subset to reflect UK primary-care reality.

designInputs.title: Safety netting: automatic alert suppression on confirmed coded clinical response
designInputs.description: The system SHALL automatically suppress a safety netting alert when a coded clinical response of an approved type is recorded against the flagged finding, writing the suppression event to the audit trail, and SHALL require a recorded rationale for any manual override of a suppressed alert.

designInputs.description: The system SHALL compare each extracted investigation result value against the active reference range for that investigation type and assign a severity band of normal, borderline, or critical, persisting the band classification on the finding node alongside the result value and the reference range version used.

designInputs.title: Safety netting: configurable follow-up time window with worklist of outstanding flagged findings
designInputs.description: The system SHALL maintain a safety netting worklist containing all findings classified as borderline or critical where no coded clinical response has been recorded within a configurable time window, surfacing each entry with patient identifier, finding type, severity band, result date, and days outstanding.

designInputs.title: Safety netting: worklist filter by severity, days outstanding, and patient cohort
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide worklist filter controls allowing a clinician to filter safety netting entries by severity band, days outstanding bucket, and patient cohort, with filter state preserved for the duration of the session.

designInputs.title: Safety netting: immutable action recording with clinician identity and timestamp
designInputs.description: The system SHALL allow a clinician to record, amend, and close a safety netting action against any flagged finding, writing the action type, free-text note, clinician identity, and timestamp immutably to the audit trail, with amendments creating a new audit record rather than overwriting the prior entry.

userNeed.title: NLP engineers need automated AI-assisted auditing of training labels with safe auto-fix and human review routing
userNeed.description: As an NLP engineer or clinical AI team member, I need an automated system that audits training label records for quality issues — assertion errors, label inconsistencies, SNOMED coding problems, and value or unit mismatches — and applies safe fixes automatically while routing SNOMED issues to human review, so that label quality is maintained at scale without requiring manual inspection of every record.

designInputs.title: Automated training-label audit with bounded auto-fix and review queues
designInputs.description: The system SHALL scan training labels for defined defect classes, apply only auto-fix rules marked safe, and route all other defects to the human review queue with reasons.

designInputs.title: Safety gate: SNOMED coding defects in training labels always routed to human review, never auto-corrected
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce that SNOMED coding defects in training labels are never auto-corrected by the audit agent; they SHALL always be routed to the human review queue, while non-SNOMED defects in the safe-fix rule set may be auto-corrected.

designInputs.title: Knowledge Graph GoldLabel as single source of truth for training data
designInputs.description: The system SHALL treat Knowledge Graph GoldLabel data as the single source of truth for model training by (a) migrating eligible legacy TrainingLabel records into GDPR-isolated TrainingCandidate and GoldLabel nodes, (b) exporting training DocBin files directly from completed GoldLabel records in the Knowledge Graph, and (c) aligning operations training UX to reference gold-dataset data and workflows instead of legacy TrainingLabel lifecycle states.

designInputs.title: Audit agent resource bounds: configurable iteration limit and token/cost budget enforcement
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce configurable per-record tool-use iteration limits and per-run token and cost budgets on the training label audit agent, halting and alerting when any limit is breached.

UNs: UN-5236129E, UN-1AC15812, UN-299200A0, UN-94833CA3, UN-5C67AAD9, UN-2C01CF40. Components: libs/training, libs/audit_agent, services/fhir_api, services/coding_worker pipeline.

designOutputs.title: Single-source GoldLabel training data and simplified operations workflow
designOutputs.description: Consolidates model-training data flow onto Knowledge Graph GoldLabel. - Adds a migration utility from legacy TrainingLabel to GoldLabel. - Updates training worker export to read completed GoldLabel records. - Simplifies operations workspace to focus on gold-data metrics and model   training actions, with direct routing to /admin/gold-dataset for data   correction workflows.

designOutputs.title: CodingMode Pipeline Routing
designOutputs.description: CodingMode enum and pipeline integration that enables two operating modes: HITL (human-in-the-loop, default) and AUTONOMOUS. The CODING_MODE environment variable controls the mode, with invalid or missing values defaulting to HITL as a fail-safe. In autonomous mode, the pipeline writes CodingDecision audit nodes and filters out Tier 3 entities. In HITL mode, all entities route to the review queue.

designOutputs.title: Agentic Training Label Auditor with Terminology Tool-Use
designOutputs.description: A two-pass automated audit system for TrainingLabel records (verification subgraph, not standalone auditor):  Pass 1 - Standard Audit (no tools): - Opus reviews every entity for span, assertion, label, and value errors - Safe auto-fixes applied immediately (assertion, label, text, value, unit) - SNOMED issues flagged as needs_review proposals - AutoFixCapMonitor tracks sliding-window fix rate  Pass 2 - Agentic Terminology Verification (tools): - Filters pass-1 results for SNOMED needs_review entities - Invokes Opus with Bedrock toolConfig for four tools:     resolve_term, get_related_concepts, get_descendants, get_second_opinion - ToolExecutor delegates terminology calls to Haiku via Terminology API - SecondOpinionProvider: blind Haiku call with only original data,     no Opus verdict or reasoning - prevents anchoring bias - Results inform Opus verdict; hard cap of 5 iterations per entity - CostGuardrail halts if token/dollar budget exceeded  API surface: POST/GET/POST /training/labels/opus-audit endpoints expose the auditor to the Operations UI (TrainingDataPanel step 3).  All tool calls (including second opinions) recorded in JSONL audit trail. SNOMED fields remain READONLY -- tool results produce proposals only.

userNeed.description: As a data protection officer or information governance lead responsible for patient data transmitted to external AI services, I need the system to automatically strip or replace all direct patient identifiers from clinical free text before it is sent to any external LLM API, so that personal health data is not transmitted to a third-party processor beyond what is strictly necessary for the clinical purpose.

designInputs.title: Physical separation of patient data and terminology data into distinct database instances
designInputs.description: The system SHALL store patient clinical data and clinical terminology data in physically separate database instances with separate credentials, with no direct database-level connections between them, so that a compromise or failure of the terminology database cannot expose or corrupt patient data.

designInputs.title: Mandatory pre-LLM de-identification safety gate enforced in LLM client wrapper with bypass prevention
designInputs.description: The system SHALL enforce a mandatory de-identification step as the first transform in every external LLM API call, implemented in the LLM client wrapper so that no caller can bypass it; the step SHALL detect and replace direct patient identifiers before text is transmitted.

designInputs.title: Patient data encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 minimum
designInputs.description: The system SHALL encrypt all patient clinical data at rest using AES-256 or equivalent, and SHALL transmit all patient data over TLS 1.2 or higher, with all encryption keys managed exclusively via Azure Key Vault, so that patient data is protected against interception and unauthorised access at the storage and transport layers.

designInputs.title: Reversible de-identification placeholder substitution with in-memory session mapping
designInputs.description: The system SHALL implement reversible placeholder substitution for patient identifiers, replacing each detected identifier with a typed placeholder token and restoring original values from an in-memory session mapping when processing LLM responses.

designOutputs.title: LLM Prompt Safety Utilities Module
designOutputs.description: Centralised module providing three prompt safety utilities used at all LLM call sites across the LEO AI pipeline:  INJECTION_GUARD (str): System prompt prefix that instructs the LLM to treat all content in data blocks as inert, regardless of its appearance. Prevents the model from following embedded instruction-like text.  sanitise_for_prompt(text, max_chars=16000): Applies a compiled regex (_INJECTION_RE) covering 15+ injection pattern families to replace matching text with [FILTERED]. Logs the substitution count at WARNING level. Truncates the result to max_chars. Default limit of 16000 chars (~4 A4 pages) preserves full clinical context to prevent coding errors from silent truncation.  cap_llm_response(raw, max_chars=1000): Truncates raw LLM output to max_chars before any parse function can operate on it. Logs a WARNING containing "response-stuffing" when truncation occurs.

designOutputs.title: Dual Neo4j Database Architecture
designOutputs.description: Implements two physically separate Neo4j database instances: one for patient and clinical data, one for terminology and reference data. This separation ensures that a breach or misconfiguration in the terminology layer cannot expose patient-identifiable information, and allows independent scaling, backup, and access-control policies for each data domain.

designOutputs.title: De-identification library + deid validator guard
designOutputs.description:
Design output documenting the data-protection surface: `libs/deid/deid.py`, `libs/utils/deidentify.py`, `libs/pipeline_graph/utils/deidentify.py`, `libs/ner/deid_validator.py`, and the encounter-coding agent's deid call. Provides regex-based NHS-identifier, postcode, DOB and name redaction with an injectable organisation pattern, and a validator that prevents PHI leaking into downstream LLM prompts.

Gaps (batch-15 Theme A): protected evaluation holdout corpus enforcement (UN-70A35225) and measured recall against a labelled PHI corpus (UN-C2F187E9 acceptance criterion ~99.9% PII recall) are not verified in CI. Backlogged.

designOutputs.title: Container Infrastructure
designOutputs.description: Azure Container Apps infrastructure defined as Bicep templates with supporting Dockerfiles for each service. The Bicep modules provision the container environment, Key Vault for secrets, and configure auto-scaling rules. Dockerfiles produce minimal, reproducible images for each ACA service; coding and analysis logic ships inside the pipeline-worker image via shared Python packages (no separate worker images).

userNeed.title: Any clinician-facing output must surface the completeness and reliability of the underlying data before a decision is made
userNeed.description: As a clinician receiving AI-generated informational context, I need to know how complete and reliable the underlying data is before I use it to inform a clinical decision, because incomplete or unrepresentative data presented without disclosure could lead me to draw incorrect conclusions and act in ways that harm the patient.

designInputs.title: Cohort metadata disclosure in clinician-facing outputs
designInputs.description: The system SHALL include cohort size, record date range, and cohort refresh date in every clinician-facing output that is derived from a matched patient cohort; these metadata fields SHALL be displayed adjacently to the output they describe.

designInputs.title: Prominent data completeness and reliability indicators on clinician outputs
designInputs.description: Every clinician-facing AI-assisted view SHALL display completeness fraction, reliability tier, and last refresh time for the underlying data before any primary action is enabled.

designInputs.title: Programme-level configuration of completeness and suppression thresholds
designInputs.description: The system SHALL store all data completeness thresholds, cohort minimum sizes, and data-gap warning floor values as named programme-level configuration parameters that can be changed by an administrator without code deployment; all changes SHALL be audit logged.

designInputs.title: Mandatory acknowledgement gate for coverage and data-gap warnings
designInputs.description: The system SHALL require explicit clinician acknowledgement before any primary clinical action can proceed when a coverage indicator is below the configured floor or a data-gap warning is active; the acknowledgement SHALL be logged with reviewer identity, timestamp, and the warning state that triggered it.

designInputs.title: Plain-language coverage indicator explanation reachable in one action
designInputs.description: The system SHALL provide a plain-language explanation of each coverage indicator, reachable within one user action from the indicator itself, that describes what the coverage fraction represents, how it is calculated, and what the impact of a low score is for the output it accompanies.

designInputs.title: Data-gap detection and mandatory disclosure for clinician-facing outputs derived from incomplete data
designInputs.description: The system SHALL detect when source data required to generate a clinician-facing output is partially or fully absent and SHALL either withhold the output or present it with a visible, plain-language data-gap warning that specifies the missing data fields; silent partial outputs without disclosure are prohibited.

designInputs.title: Small-cohort output suppression and low-confidence flagging
designInputs.description: The system SHALL suppress or flag with an explicit low-confidence warning any cohort-based output where the matched patient cohort is smaller than the configured minimum size threshold; the warning SHALL state the actual cohort size and the threshold applied, and SHALL prevent primary clinical actions until acknowledged.

designOutputs.title: _rescue_diagnosis_for_open_episode helper + _build_open_episode wiring
designOutputs.description: Adds a pure helper function to ``_builder.py`` -- ``_rescue_diagnosis_for_open_episode(diagnosis_anchors, site_key, ref_date)`` -- that returns ``(earliest_diag_date, anchors_on_that_date)`` when at least one site-compatible confirmed diagnosis anchor falls in ``[ref_date, ref_date + STALE_HARD_DAYS]``, and ``None`` otherwise. The helper applies the existing ``_extract_condition_key_from_anchor`` and ``_site_keys_compatible`` helpers so a specific-site diagnosis must match the referral site while ``unknown`` / ``non_site_specific`` diagnoses are eligible for any site.  ``_build_open_episode`` is updated to call this helper AFTER specialist-letter inference and benign-closure detection have run and AFTER ``_first_seen_link_anchors`` has been moved before ``_write_episode`` (defect fix from DI-LEO-AI-145). When the computed status is ``in_progress`` and the helper returns a rescue, the builder sets ``status = 'completed'``, ``end_date = rescue_date.isoformat()``, ``hitl_flag = True``, and ``hitl_reason = 'Auto-completed: confirmed cancer diagnosis text in episode window. Verify cancer site and pathway outcome.'``. The diagnosis anchors at the earliest rescue date are passed to ``_link_encounters_to_episode`` with milestone_type ``'diagnosis_confirmed'`` so the IS_PART_OF edge is written in the same builder pass.

userNeed.title: Operations teams need automated detection of longitudinal drift in coding patterns with root cause labelling and escalating alerts
userNeed.description: As an operations team member, I need automated detection of longitudinal drift in audit coding patterns so that systematic model degradation or clinical practice changes are identified and escalated before they corrupt trend reporting.

designInputs.title: Audit quality loops: root cause labelling of drift alerts with 2-year immutable alert history
designInputs.description: The system SHALL label each drift alert with a root cause category of model-change-correlated, config-change-correlated, or unexplained, based on whether a model version or pipeline config change was recorded within the comparison window, and SHALL retain alert history immutably for a minimum of 2 years.

designInputs.title: Audit quality loops: per-entity-type coding frequency drift detection with configurable threshold
designInputs.description: The system SHALL compute the coding frequency distribution per entity type per programme at each audit period boundary, compare consecutive period distributions, and generate an alert when the delta for any entity type exceeds the configurable drift threshold.
